```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE,   # warnings stay visible

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# ---- Repository root (portable) ---------------------------------------------
# Walk up from this file to the folder holding scripts/00_run_all.R. Set the
# RHD_REPO_ROOT environment variable when rendering a copy outside the repo.
find_repo_root <- function() {
  env <- Sys.getenv("RHD_REPO_ROOT")
  if (nzchar(env)) return(normalizePath(env, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
  d <- tryCatch(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), error = function(e) getwd())
  d <- normalizePath(d, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(d, "scripts", "00_run_all.R")) &&
        file.exists(file.path(d, "R", "abcd_engine.R"))) return(d)
    up <- dirname(d)
    if (identical(up, d))
      stop("Cannot find the repository root (folder holding scripts/00_run_all.R). ",
           "Set RHD_REPO_ROOT.", call. = FALSE)
    d <- up
  }
}
ROOT      <- find_repo_root()
COUNTRIES <- c("Indonesia", "Uganda")
ENGINE    <- "abcd_first_diagnosis_v1_adult_prog_mult_sap55"   # the engine this deck is written for (v1 + adult progression hazard multiplier + assumed 55% SAP progression-hazard reduction, 6 Nov 2026)

# ---- Saved artifacts only: the deck never runs or modifies the pipeline -------
artifact <- function(script, ...) {
  p <- file.path(ROOT, ...)
  if (!file.exists(p))
    stop("Missing pipeline artifact: ", p, "\n  Produced by scripts/", script,
         " (run scripts/00_run_all.R with the matching COUNTRY). ",
         "The deck reads saved results only and never re-runs the model.", call. = FALSE)
  p
}
load_country <- function(ct) list(
  out  = readRDS(artifact("06_run_prevention_model.R", "output", ct, "out_model", paste0(ct, ".rds"))),
  econ = readRDS(artifact("08_economic_evaluation.R", "output", ct, "tables", "rhd_economic_results.rds")),
  bs   = readRDS(artifact("05_build_baseline.R", "data", ct, "baseline_state.rds")),
  cal  = readRDS(artifact("04_calibration_random_tp.R and 04b_calibrate_structural.R",
                          "data", ct, "calibrated_rhd_parameters.rds")),
  gbd  = as.data.table(readRDS(artifact("01_prepare_inputs.R", "data", ct, "temp_baseline_rates_gbd.rds"))))
D <- setNames(lapply(COUNTRIES, load_country), COUNTRIES)

# Input-integrity checks stop the render with the files involved and the upstream
# fix. They test consistency of the saved artifacts, never an expected result.
check <- function(ok, msg, fix = "re-run scripts/00_run_all.R for that COUNTRY")
  if (!isTRUE(ok)) stop("Deck input check failed: ", msg, "\n  Upstream regeneration needed: ", fix, call. = FALSE)

# ---- Formatting (strings are valid in markdown and in LaTeX table cells) ------
fmt_n   <- function(x, d = 0) formatC(round(x, d), format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")
fmt_h   <- function(x) fmt_n(round(x, -2))                       # nearest hundred
fmt_pct <- function(x, d = 0) paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = d), "\\%")
fmt_cov <- function(x) paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = 2, drop0trailing = TRUE), "\\%")
fmt_usd <- function(x, d = 0) paste0("US\\$", fmt_n(x, d))
fmt_bn  <- function(x, d = 2) paste0("US\\$", formatC(x / 1e9, format = "f", digits = d), " bn")
fmt_mn  <- function(x, d = 1) paste0(formatC(x / 1e6, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ","), " m")
fmt_x   <- function(x, d = 1) paste0(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d), "$\\times$")
fmt_f   <- function(x, d = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d)
fmt_e   <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 1)
fmt_int <- function(x, d = 0) paste0("int\\$", fmt_n(x, d))                     # international dollars
tex_lab <- function(x) gsub("$", "\\$", x, fixed = TRUE)                         # 08 labels -> LaTeX text
# VSL path as saved by 08 (reference-case default): the annual derivation reproduces the
# incremental table's VSL, the unfloored anchor grows at the time elasticity, the floor
# applies every year, and int$ of the anchor year convert to constant 2025 US$ with the
# saved PPP, CPI and exchange-rate factors. Labels must say constant 2025 US$.
vsl_ok <- function(econ, inc) {
  vd <- econ$vsl_derivation; lb <- econ$report_labels
  if (is.null(vd) || is.null(lb)) return(FALSE)
  va <- as.data.table(vd$annual); a <- vd$anchor; m <- match(inc$year, va$year)
  !anyNA(m) && identical(lb$currency, "USD") && identical(as.integer(lb$price_year), 2025L) &&
    max(abs(inc$vsl / va$vsl_usd2025[m] - 1)) < 1e-12 &&
    max(abs(va$raw_vsl_intY / (a$raw_vsl_anchor_intY * va$income_growth_index^a$time_elasticity) - 1)) < 1e-10 &&
    max(abs(va$vsl_intY / pmax(va$raw_vsl_intY, va$floor_vsl_intY, na.rm = TRUE) - 1)) < 1e-12 &&
    max(abs(va$vsl_usd2025 / (va$vsl_intY * a$intY_to_usd2025) - 1)) < 1e-10
}
# A ratio to one in words ("15\% below", "8\% above", "within 1\% of").
rel_phrase <- function(r, tol = 0.01) {
  if (length(r) != 1 || !is.finite(r)) return("not comparable with")
  if (abs(r - 1) < tol) return(paste0("within ", fmt_pct(tol), " of"))
  paste0(fmt_pct(abs(r - 1)), if (r < 1) " below" else " above")
}
# Scale-up relative to reference ("63\% smaller", "essentially unchanged").
chg_phrase <- function(new, old, up = "larger", down = "smaller", d = 0, tol = 5e-5) {
  if (length(old) != 1 || !is.finite(old) || old == 0) return("not defined")
  r <- new / old - 1
  if (abs(r) < tol) return("essentially unchanged")
  paste(fmt_pct(abs(r), d), if (r < 0) down else up)
}
pf <- function(ok) if (isTRUE(ok)) "PASS" else "\\textbf{\\textcolor{casefatalcol}{FAIL}}"
grp_lo <- setNames(c(0, 1, 2, 5, seq(10, 95, by = 5)),
                   c("<1 year", "12-23 months", "2-4 years", "5-9 years", paste0(seq(10, 90, by = 5), "-", seq(14, 94, by = 5), " years"), "95+ years"))

# ---- Integrity checks (first-diagnosis structure), per country -------------------
CARE_VEC <- c("screen_window_prob", "clinical_detection", "bpg_initiation", "bpg_retention",
              "adherence_good", "adherence_partial", "surgery")
STG_COV  <- c(screen_window_prob = "screen_window_prob", clinical_detection = "clinical_detection",
              bpg_initiation = "bpg_initiation", bpg_retention = "bpg_retention",
              adherence_good = "adherence_good", adherence_partial = "adherence_partial", surgery = "surgery_coverage")
for (ct in COUNTRIES) {
  d  <- D[[ct]]
  w  <- as.data.table(d$out$wsd); s <- as.data.table(d$out$stages)
  yy <- as.integer(d$out$meta$years); sc <- d$cal$stage_calibration; bp <- sc$best_parameters
  st <- d$bs$states[[1]]; cv <- st$coverage; ef <- st$effects; nh <- st$natural_history
  fx <- paste("re-run 05 -> 08 for", ct)
  # identity of country, scenarios, years
  check(identical(unique(as.character(w$location)), ct) && identical(unique(as.character(s$location)), ct),
        paste(ct, "model output holds another location"))
  check(identical(d$bs$locations, ct) && identical(d$cal$meta$location, ct) && identical(unique(d$gbd$location_name), ct),
        paste(ct, "baseline / calibration bundle / GBD extract holds another location"))
  check(setequal(unique(w$scenario), c("ref", "sap")) && setequal(unique(s$scenario), c("ref", "sap")),
        paste(ct, "scenarios are not exactly ref + sap"))
  check(identical(sort(unique(as.integer(w$year))), yy) && identical(as.integer(d$bs$meta$years), yy) &&
          identical(sort(as.integer(d$econ$incremental$year)), yy),
        paste(ct, "analysis years differ across model, baseline and economics"), fx)
  # one engine and one specification across 04b, 05 and 06
  check(!grepl("^FAILED", as.character(sc$status)) && !is.null(bp) && identical(sc$statuses$structural, "ok"),
        paste(ct, "Layer-2 calibration status is", sc$status), paste("fix and re-run 04b -> 08 for", ct))
  check(identical(sc$spec$engine_spec, ENGINE) && identical(bp$engine_spec, ENGINE) &&
          identical(d$bs$meta$engine_spec, ENGINE) && identical(d$out$meta$engine_spec, ENGINE) &&
          identical(d$out$diag$engine_spec, ENGINE),
        paste(ct, "artifacts were not all produced by engine", ENGINE), paste("re-run 03 -> 08 for", ct))
  spec <- c(sc$spec$mortality_structure, sc$spec$sap_mechanism)
  check(identical(spec, c(d$bs$meta$mortality_structure, d$bs$meta$sap_mechanism)) &&
          identical(spec, c(d$out$meta$mortality_structure, d$out$meta$sap_mechanism)) &&
          identical(spec, c(d$out$diag$mortality_structure, d$out$diag$sap_mechanism)),
        paste(ct, "mortality structure / SAP mechanism differ between calibration, baseline and model"), fx)
  SAP_F <- c("sap_progression_rrr", "sap_progression_hazard_mult", "sap_protection_age_max", "sap_effect_transitions",
             "sap_hr_prior_A_to_B_adult", "sap_hr_C_to_D", "sap_hr_D_to_rhd_death")
  check(identical(sc$spec$sap_eligibility, ef$sap_eligibility) && all(SAP_F %in% names(sc$spec$sap_hr)) &&
          identical(sc$spec$sap_hr[SAP_F], ef[SAP_F]) && identical(d$bs$meta$sap_hr[SAP_F], ef[SAP_F]),
        paste(ct, "SAP eligibility / progression-multiplier specification differs between calibration and baseline"), paste("re-run 04b -> 08 for", ct))
  check(identical(sc$spec$entry_mix_child, nh$entry_mix_child) && identical(sc$spec$entry_mix_adult, nh$entry_mix_adult) &&
          identical(sc$spec$child_last_age, nh$child_last_age),
        paste(ct, "entry mixes / age convention differ between calibration and baseline"), fx)
  # adult progression hazard multiplier: same value in calibration and baseline; effective adult B->C / C->D = 1 - (1 - p)^m
  m_ct <- nh$adult_prog_hazard_mult
  check(length(m_ct) == 1L && is.finite(m_ct) && m_ct > 0 && identical(sc$spec$adult_prog_hazard_mult, m_ct) &&
          identical(bp$natural_history_fixed$adult_prog_hazard_mult, m_ct) &&
          isTRUE(all.equal(c(nh$derived$p_B_to_C_adult, nh$derived$p_C_to_D_adult),
                           1 - (1 - c(st$transitions$p_B_to_C, st$transitions$p_C_to_D))^m_ct, tolerance = 1e-12)),
        paste(ct, "adult progression hazard multiplier missing / inconsistent, or effective adult B->C / C->D differ from 1 - (1 - p)^m"),
        paste("re-run 03 -> 08 for", ct))
  # calibrated parameters and the analysis-start state are the ones the model ran
  check(isTRUE(all.equal(unlist(st$transitions), unlist(bp$transitions))) && isTRUE(all.equal(st$p_rhd_death, bp$p_rhd_death)),
        paste(ct, "baseline transitions / D mortality differ from the calibrated best parameters"), fx)
  es_ <- bp$initial_state$engine_state
  check(!is.null(es_) && setequal(names(es_), names(st$seed_state)) &&
          all(vapply(names(es_), function(k) isTRUE(all.equal(unname(es_[[k]]), unname(st$seed_state[[k]]))), NA)),
        paste(ct, "the model seed differs from the 04b bridged engine state"), fx)
  # reference care in the calibration == reference arm (every care field, constants and initial shares)
  rc <- bp$reference_care_in_calibration
  check(all(vapply(CARE_VEC, function(k) abs(rc[[k]] - cv$ref[[k]][1]) < 1e-12 && diff(range(cv$ref[[k]])) < 1e-12, NA)) &&
          all(vapply(c("sensitivity", "confirm_completion", "confirm_sensitivity", "partial_relative_protection",
                       "screen_age_lo", "screen_age_hi"), function(k) isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(rc[[k]]), as.numeric(cv$constants[[k]]))), NA)) &&
          isTRUE(all.equal(rc$init[c("diagnosed_share", "on_bpg_share", "ever_screened_share")],
                           cv$init[c("diagnosed_share", "on_bpg_share", "ever_screened_share")])),
        paste(ct, "reference care used in the calibration differs from the reference arm"), paste("re-run 04b -> 08 for", ct))
  # the model ran the baseline's care trajectories, arm by arm
  cv_out <- s[, lapply(.SD, `[`, 1), by = .(scenario, year), .SDcols = unname(STG_COV)]
  cv_ok <- all(vapply(c("ref", "sap"), function(a) {
    o <- cv_out[scenario == a][order(year)]
    all(vapply(names(STG_COV), function(k) max(abs(o[[STG_COV[[k]]]] - cv[[a]][[k]])) < 1e-12, NA)) }, NA))
  check(cv_ok, paste(ct, "care trajectories in the model output differ from baseline_state"), paste("re-run 06 -> 08 for", ct))
  check(isTRUE(all.equal(cv$ref$surgery, cv$sap$surgery)), paste(ct, "surgery coverage differs by arm"), fx)
  # structural identities of the run
  check(all(is.finite(as.matrix(w[, .(well, sick, newcases, dead, pop, all.mx)]))), paste(ct, "non-finite values in the aggregate model table"))
  pp <- dcast(w[, .(pop = sum(pop)), by = .(scenario, year)], year ~ scenario, value.var = "pop")
  check(max(abs(pp$ref - pp$sap)) < 1e-6, paste(ct, "arms do not share one population"))
  ab <- merge(s[, .(stg = A + B + C + D, care = undiagnosed_end + diagnosed_end), by = .(scenario, year, sex, age)],
              w[, .(scenario, year, sex, age, sick)], by = c("scenario", "year", "sex", "age"))
  check(nrow(ab) == nrow(w) && max(abs(ab$stg - ab$sick), abs(ab$care - ab$sick)) < 1e-6,
        paste(ct, "stages A-D or undiagnosed + diagnosed do not reconstruct the classifiable RHD stock"))
  check(s[, all(rhd_deaths_A == 0 & rhd_deaths_B == 0 & rhd_deaths_C == 0)] && all(st$p_rhd_death[c("A", "B", "C")] == 0),
        paste(ct, "D-only run has RHD deaths outside stage D"), fx)
  check(s[age > nh$child_last_age, all(A == 0 & n_on_bpg_A == 0)] && s[age <= nh$child_last_age, all(prior_A_end == 0)],
        paste(ct, "classifiable A / A on BPG at adult ages, or prior-A at child ages"), fx)
  # progression-mode SAP trace: on-BPG multipliers = 1 - adherence x (1 - M(age)), M(age) = M at attained age <= cutoff, else 1
  mAge <- ifelse(s$age <= ef$sap_protection_age_max, ef$sap_progression_hazard_mult, 1)
  check(s[, max(abs(eff_cf - 1))] < 1e-12 &&
          max(abs(s$sap_prog_mult_A_to_B - (1 - s$sap_adherence_factor * (1 - mAge)))) < 1e-9 &&
          max(abs(s$sap_prog_mult_B_to_C - (1 - s$sap_adherence_factor * (1 - mAge)))) < 1e-9 &&
          max(abs(s$sap_prog_mult_C_to_D - 1)) < 1e-12,
        paste(ct, "progression-mode SAP trace does not match the saved assumed multiplier, protection age and adherence"), fx)
  # care nesting and volumes consistent with the stage table and 06 diagnostics
  check(s[, all(n_on_optimal_treatment <= n_bpg_eligible_diagnosed + 1e-9 & n_bpg_eligible_diagnosed <= n_diagnosed + 1e-9 &
                  n_diagnosed <= living_rhd_start + 1e-9 & n_dx_screen <= n_confirm_completed + 1e-9 &
                  n_confirm_completed <= n_screen_true_positive + 1e-9)] &&
          s[, max(abs(n_on_optimal_treatment - n_on_bpg_A - n_on_bpg_B), abs(n_new_diagnoses - n_dx_screen - n_dx_clinical))] < 1e-6,
        paste(ct, "diagnosis / BPG volumes are not nested in their eligible stocks"), fx)
  vol6 <- s[, .(enc = sum(n_screened), py = sum(n_on_optimal_treatment)), by = .(scenario, year)]
  dg <- merge(as.data.table(d$out$diag$screening_by_year)[, .(scenario, year, encounters)],
              as.data.table(d$out$diag$sap_trace_by_year)[, .(scenario, year, on_bpg_person_years)], by = c("scenario", "year"))
  vv <- merge(vol6, dg, by = c("scenario", "year"))
  check(nrow(vv) == 2L * length(yy) && vv[, max(abs(enc - encounters) / pmax(encounters, 1), abs(py - on_bpg_person_years) / pmax(on_bpg_person_years, 1))] < 1e-9,
        paste(ct, "screening encounters / SAP person-years differ between the stage table and 06 diagnostics"), fx)
  # economics computed from this run: deaths, costs (recomputed from volumes), VSL-only valuation
  inc_ct <- as.data.table(d$econ$incremental); ep_ct <- d$econ$params
  dd <- dcast(w[, .(d = sum(dead)), by = .(scenario, year)], year ~ scenario, value.var = "d")
  ee <- merge(dd, inc_ct[, .(year, deaths_avert, cost_ref, cost_sap)], by = "year")
  cc <- dcast(s[, .(c = sum(n_screened) * ep_ct$cost_screen_per_person + sum(n_on_optimal_treatment) * ep_ct$cost_sap_per_year +
                       sum(total_surgeries) * ep_ct$cost_surgery), by = .(scenario, year)], year ~ scenario, value.var = "c")
  ee <- merge(ee, cc, by = "year", suffixes = c("", "_recalc"))
  check(nrow(ee) == length(yy) && max(abs(ee$ref - ee$sap - ee$deaths_avert)) < 1e-6 &&
          ee[, max(abs(ref_recalc - cost_ref) / pmax(cost_ref, 1), abs(sap_recalc - cost_sap) / pmax(cost_sap, 1))] < 1e-9,
        paste(ct, "saved economics were not computed from this model run"), paste("re-run 08 for", ct))
  check(all(inc_ct$benefit_gdp == 0) && isTRUE(all.equal(inc_ct$benefit_total, inc_ct$benefit_vsl)) &&
          max(abs(inc_ct$benefit_total - inc_ct$deaths_avert * inc_ct$vsl)) < 1e-6 * max(1, abs(inc_ct$benefit_total)) &&
          vsl_ok(d$econ, inc_ct),
        paste(ct, "economics predate the 2025-US$ reference-case VSL valuation"), paste("re-run 08 for", ct))
  conf <- dcast(s[, .(n = sum(n_confirm_completed)), by = .(scenario, year)], year ~ scenario, value.var = "n")
  bi <- merge(as.data.table(d$econ$budget_impact)[, .(year, confirmations_incremental_uncosted)], conf, by = "year")
  check(!is.null(ep_ct$uncosted_items) && nrow(bi) == length(yy) &&
          max(abs(bi$confirmations_incremental_uncosted - (bi$sap - bi$ref))) < 1e-6,
        paste(ct, "the uncosted confirmation volume is not flagged / does not match the run"), paste("re-run 08 for", ct))
  check(nrow(d$econ$summary[location == ct]) == 1, paste(ct, "economic summary row missing"))
  check(!is.null(d$out$meta$calibration_adequacy) && !is.null(d$out$meta$observation_definitions),
        paste(ct, "model output lacks the calibration-adequacy / observation-definition record"), fx)
}
check(identical(D$Indonesia$out$meta$years, D$Uganda$out$meta$years), "Indonesia and Uganda runs cover different analysis years")
check(D$Indonesia$econ$discount_base_year == D$Uganda$econ$discount_base_year, "countries use different discount base years")

# ---- Per-country results computed from the saved objects ---------------------
summarise_country <- function(ct) {
  d  <- D[[ct]]; meta <- d$out$meta
  w  <- as.data.table(d$out$wsd); s <- as.data.table(d$out$stages)
  ep <- d$econ$params; dby <- d$econ$discount_base_year
  yy <- as.integer(meta$years); y0 <- min(yy); y1 <- max(yy); ye <- as.integer(meta$ramp_end)
  cal <- d$cal; sc <- cal$stage_calibration; oc <- sc$objective_components; bp <- sc$best_parameters
  eda <- sc$excess_death_attribution
  st0 <- d$bs$states[[1]]; cv <- st0$coverage; tr <- st0$transitions; nh <- st0$natural_history
  ef <- st0$effects; sg <- st0$surgery; b <- nh$child_last_age
  prev_obs <- sc$spec$prev_obs
  agg <- merge(
    w[, .(pop = sum(pop), newcases = sum(newcases), sick = sum(sick), dead = sum(dead)), by = .(scenario, year)],
    s[, .(prev_start = sum(living_rhd_start), undiag = sum(undiagnosed_end), diag = sum(diagnosed_end), on_bpg = sum(on_bpg_end),
          A = sum(A), B = sum(B), C = sum(C), D = sum(D), D_start = sum(D_start), prior_A = sum(prior_A_end), normalised = sum(normalised_end),
          dead_child = sum(rhd_deaths[age < 20]), enc = sum(n_screened), tp = sum(n_screen_true_positive), conf = sum(n_confirm_completed),
          dx = sum(n_new_diagnoses), dx_scr = sum(n_dx_screen), dx_clin = sum(n_dx_clinical),
          dxA = sum(n_dx_A), dxB = sum(n_dx_B), dxC = sum(n_dx_C), dxD = sum(n_dx_D),
          sap_py = sum(n_on_optimal_treatment), sap_A = sum(n_on_bpg_A), sap_B = sum(n_on_bpg_B), sap_B_adult = sum(n_on_bpg_B[age > b]),
          sap_B_noben = sum(n_on_bpg_B[age > ef$sap_protection_age_max]),
          surg = sum(total_surgeries), reentry = sum(reentry_prior_A_to_B), reclass = sum(reclass_A_to_prior_A),
          eff_prot = sum(n_effectively_protected),
          eff_prot_noben = sum(n_effectively_protected[age > ef$sap_protection_age_max])), by = .(scenario, year)],
    by = c("scenario", "year"))
  agg[, prev_obs := switch(prev_obs, start = prev_start, end = sick, mid = 0.5 * (prev_start + sick))]
  wide <- dcast(agg, year ~ scenario, value.var = c("pop", "newcases", "sick", "prev_obs", "dead", "dx", "enc", "sap_py", "D"))
  wide[, averted := dead_ref - dead_sap]
  # GBD published counts (burden statement)
  g <- d$gbd[metric_name == "Number" & cause_name == "Rheumatic heart disease",
             .(val = sum(val)), by = .(measure = measure_name, year)]
  g_last <- max(g$year)
  # calibration fit
  fy <- as.data.table(sc$fit_by_year); fl <- as.data.table(sc$fit_by_group_year); fl[, glo := grp_lo[age_group]]
  tol <- as.data.table(sc$fit_tolerance_summary)
  cy <- as.integer(cal$meta$calib_year_end); mf <- as.integer(oc$match_from)
  ftg <- function(m, y = cy, col = "target") fy[measure == m & year == y][[col]]
  mech <- list(
    cf_child = ftg("Deaths 0-19") / ftg("Prevalence 0-19"), cf_adult = ftg("Deaths 20+") / ftg("Prevalence 20+"),
    prev_2024 = fl[year == cy & measure == "Prevalence" & age_group == "20-24 years", sum(model) / sum(target_used, na.rm = TRUE)],
    prev_60p = fl[year == cy & measure == "Prevalence" & glo >= 60, sum(model) / sum(target_used, na.rm = TRUE)],
    gbd_cf_change = (ftg("Deaths") / ftg("Prevalence")) / (ftg("Deaths", mf) / ftg("Prevalence", mf)) - 1,
    gbd_dead_change = ftg("Deaths") / ftg("Deaths", mf) - 1, gbd_prev_change = ftg("Prevalence") / ftg("Prevalence", mf) - 1,
    death_drift = ftg("Deaths", cy, "ratio") / ftg("Deaths", mf, "ratio") - 1)
  # stage D
  dfa <- as.data.table(sc$d_fatality)[year == cy & ages == "all"]
  # service volumes and discounted incremental cost by component (08's definitions)
  cc <- agg[, .(screen = enc * ep$cost_screen_per_person, sap = sap_py * ep$cost_sap_per_year,
                surg = surg * ep$cost_surgery), by = .(scenario, year)]
  cc[, df := 1 / (1 + ep$disc_rate)^(year - dby)]
  ccw <- dcast(cc, year + df ~ scenario, value.var = c("screen", "sap", "surg"))
  comp <- ccw[, c(screen = sum((screen_sap - screen_ref) * df), sap = sum((sap_sap - sap_ref) * df),
                  surg = sum((surg_sap - surg_ref) * df))]
  es <- as.list(d$econ$summary[location == ct])
  inc <- as.data.table(d$econ$incremental)
  t50 <- inc[year <= ye, .(cost = sum(inc_cost * df), ben = sum(benefit_total * df), da = sum(deaths_avert))]
  check(abs(sum(comp) - es$total_cost) / abs(es$total_cost) < 1e-8, paste(ct, "cost recomputation differs from 08"),
        paste("re-run 08 for", ct))
  conf_unc <- sum(as.data.table(d$econ$budget_impact)$confirmations_incremental_uncosted)
  hr <- c(M = ef$sap_progression_hazard_mult, RRR = ef$sap_progression_rrr, age_max = ef$sap_protection_age_max,
          C_to_D = ef$sap_hr_C_to_D)
  adh <- function(a, i) cv[[a]]$adherence_factor[i]
  first_eff <- wide[abs(averted) > 1e-6, suppressWarnings(min(year))]
  ycut <- function(arm, y) agg[scenario == arm & year == y]
  list(
    ct = ct, y0 = y0, y1 = y1, ye = ye, yy = yy, wide = wide, agg = agg, g = g, g_last = g_last,
    comp = comp, es = es, inc = inc, t50 = t50, ep = ep, dby = dby,
    va = d$econ$vsl_derivation$anchor, vsl0 = inc[year == y0, vsl], vsl1 = inc[year == y1, vsl],
    pfac = d$econ$price_adjustment$adjustment_factor[1], xr_int = d$econ$int_conversion$usd_to_int_2025,
    ben_late = inc[, sum((benefit_total * df)[year > ye]) / sum(benefit_total * df)],
    cv = cv, tr = tr, nh = nh, ef = ef, sg = sg, hr = hr, adh = adh, b = b, trend = meta$incidence_trend,
    m_ad = nh$adult_prog_hazard_mult, bc_ad = nh$derived$p_B_to_C_adult, cd_ad = nh$derived$p_C_to_D_adult,
    cal = cal, sc = sc, oc = oc, eda = eda, bp = bp, fy = fy, fl = fl, tol = tol, cy = cy, mf = mf, mech = mech, dfa = dfa,
    prev_obs = prev_obs, basis = sc$spec$target_basis, ptab = as.data.table(sc$parameters),
    ident = as.data.table(sc$identifiability), conf_unc = conf_unc, first_eff = first_eff, ycut = ycut,
    averted = wide[, sum(averted)], averted_ye = wide[year <= ye, sum(averted)],
    rel_cum = 1 - wide[, sum(dead_sap) / sum(dead_ref)],
    rate_red_ye = wide[year == ye, 1 - (dead_sap / pop_sap) / (dead_ref / pop_ref)],
    deaths_y0 = wide[year == y0, dead_ref], prev_y0 = wide[year == y0, prev_obs_ref],
    gbd_prev = g[measure == "Prevalence" & year == g_last, val], gbd_deaths = g[measure == "Deaths" & year == g_last, val],
    adequacy = sub(" \\(.*$", "", meta$calibration_adequacy),
    fit_ok = isTRUE(sc$statuses$fit_within_tolerance), burn_ok = isTRUE(sc$statuses$burn_in_converged),
    conv_ok = all(as.data.table(sc$convergence)$convergence_code == 0),
    struct_ok = identical(sc$statuses$structural, "ok"),
    D_share_y0 = ycut("ref", y0)$D_start / ycut("ref", y0)$prev_start,
    adultB_share_ye = ycut("sap", ye)$sap_B_adult / ycut("sap", ye)$sap_py,
    nobenB_share_ye = ycut("sap", ye)$sap_B_noben / ycut("sap", ye)$sap_py,
    noben_prot_share_ye = ycut("sap", ye)$eff_prot_noben / ycut("sap", ye)$eff_prot)
}
R <- setNames(lapply(COUNTRIES, summarise_country), COUNTRIES)
I <- R$Indonesia; U <- R$Uganda
Y0 <- I$y0; Y1 <- I$y1; YE <- I$ye; CY <- I$cy; MF <- I$mf; BAGE <- I$b
# SAP default (identical across countries: checked via SPEC$sap_hr above). Published evidence figures are stated
# as such; M, RRR and the protection age are read from the saved specification.
M_SAP <- I$ef$sap_progression_hazard_mult; RRR_SAP <- I$ef$sap_progression_rrr; AMAX <- as.integer(I$ef$sap_protection_age_max)
EV_RR <- 0.45                                     # Manyemba et al. (Cochrane, PMID 12137650): RR for recurrent RF (published figure)
A_ILLUS <- 0.90                                   # ILLUSTRATIVE adherence weight (not the reference schedule)
eff_m <- function(a) 1 - a * (1 - M_SAP)         # on-BPG multiplier at protected ages
SAP_LABEL <- "assumed 55\\% reduction in progression hazards (expert-informed scenario), informed by evidence on prevention of recurrent rheumatic fever"
basis_label <- if (identical(I$basis, "number")) "GBD published counts" else "GBD rate $\\times$ WPP population"

read_sheet <- function(...) {
  p <- file.path(ROOT, ...)
  if (!file.exists(p) || !requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) return(NULL)

num_cells <- function(v) { v <- trimws(unlist(v)); as.numeric(v[!is.na(v) & grepl("^[0-9.]+([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$", v)]) }
tp_map <- c("Stage A to Normal" = "p_A_to_no_rhd", "Stage A to B" = "p_A_to_B", "Stage B to A" = "p_B_to_A",
            "Stage B to C" = "p_B_to_C", "Stage C to B" = "p_C_to_B", "Stage C to D" = "p_C_to_D",
            "Stage D to C" = "p_D_to_C")
tp_lab <- c(p_A_to_no_rhd = "A $\\rightarrow$ normalised", p_A_to_B = "A $\\rightarrow$ B",
            p_B_to_A = "B $\\rightarrow$ A", p_B_to_C = "B $\\rightarrow$ C", p_C_to_B = "C $\\rightarrow$ B",
            p_C_to_D = "C $\\rightarrow$ D", p_D_to_C = "D $\\rightarrow$ C")
tp_rows <- names(tp_lab)
lit_x <- read_sheet("dev", "Summary progression rates_Sep26Update.xlsx")
LIT <- if (is.null(lit_x)) NULL else {
  lab <- trimws(lit_x[[1]]); t2 <- grep("^Table 2", lab); t3 <- grep("^Table 3", lab)
  rows <- seq(t2 + 1, t3 - 1)
  rbindlist(lapply(names(tp_map), function(nm) {
    v <- num_cells(lit_x[rows[lab[rows] == nm][1], -1])
    data.table(par = tp_map[[nm]], n = length(v), lo = min(v), hi = max(v))
  }))
}

  rbindlist(lapply(COUNTRIES, function(ct) {
    r <- which(trimws(dd_x[[1]]) == ct & trimws(dd_x[[2]]) == "All ages")[1]
    data.table(ct = ct, lit = as.numeric(dd_x[r, jl]) / 100, gbd_hf = as.numeric(dd_x[r, jg]) / 100)

# ---- Checkpoint note (dev/): scratch-only alternative tests, parsed read-only -----
ck_p <- file.path(ROOT, "dev", "checkpoint_first_diagnosis_2026-11-05.md")
ALT <- NULL
if (file.exists(ck_p)) {
  ck <- readLines(ck_p, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  h <- grep("^\\| Variant", ck)
  if (length(h)) {
    j <- h + 2L; rows <- character()
    while (j <= length(ck) && grepl("^\\|", ck[j])) { rows <- c(rows, ck[j]); j <- j + 1L }
    cells <- lapply(rows, function(r) trimws(strsplit(sub("^\\|", "", sub("\\|\\s*$", "", r)), "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]))
    clean <- function(x) { x <- gsub("\\*\\*", "", x); x <- gsub("✓", "(in tol.)", x, fixed = TRUE)
      x <- gsub("–", "--", x, fixed = TRUE); x <- gsub("→", " to ", x, fixed = TRUE); x <- gsub("%", "\\\\%", x); x }
    ALT <- as.data.table(do.call(rbind, lapply(cells, clean)))
    if (ncol(ALT) != 6L) ALT <- NULL
  }
}

kb <- function(df, align, widths = NULL, font = NULL) {
  k <- kbl(df, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, align = align, escape = FALSE, linesep = "",
           row.names = FALSE)
  k <- kable_styling(k, position = "center", font_size = font)
  if (!is.null(widths)) for (i in seq_along(widths)) if (!is.na(widths[i])) k <- column_spec(k, i, width = widths[i])
  k
}
```

\srcline Statuses read from the saved calibration and model outputs. Model update (6 Nov 2026): adult B$\rightarrow$C and C$\rightarrow$D hazards fixed at \prov{`r fmt_f(M_AD)`$\times$} the childhood hazards; SAP: assumed `r fmt_pct(RRR_SAP)` progression-hazard reduction (\prov{$M$ = `r fmt_f(M_SAP, 2)`}, ages $\leq `r AMAX`$) replaces the GOAL child HRs; both countries recalibrated and re-run. 05--08 were run with the fit outside tolerance by explicit user decision. Confirmatory echo is \prov{not costed}. Tolerances: |log ratio| $<$ `r fmt_f(I$sc$spec$fit_tolerances[["prevalence"]])` (prevalence), `r fmt_f(I$sc$spec$fit_tolerances[["deaths"]])` (deaths).

::: notes
Time: 1.5 min (cumulative 1.5). Say this first: everything that follows is a numerically complete run of a model whose calibration does not yet reproduce GBD. Deaths are `r fmt_f(I$deaths_y0 / I$gbd_deaths, 1)` times GBD in Indonesia and `r fmt_f(U$deaths_y0 / U$gbd_deaths, 1)` times in Uganda at the start of the projection. This version adds one fixed common adult progression hazard multiplier of `r fmt_f(M_AD)` on B to C and C to D; it narrows the adult death excess but does not close it. The SAP effect is now an assumed `r fmt_pct(RRR_SAP)` reduction in A to B and B to C hazards on BPG up to age `r AMAX`, an expert-informed scenario rather than an estimate. The user chose to complete the pipeline anyway to see preliminary outputs; calibration improvement comes next. Transition: the question the model is built to answer.
:::

## We ask what scaling up echo screening and prophylaxis would buy, and at what cost

1. **Health:** how many rheumatic heart disease (RHD) deaths does scale-up avert in Indonesia and Uganda, `r Y0`–`r Y1`?
2. **Services:** how many screens, confirmatory echoes, first diagnoses and prophylaxis person-years does it add?
3. **Value:** does the monetised benefit exceed the incremental cost?

\medskip

Scope: national, both sexes, ages 0–100+; secondary prevention (screening, confirmation, benzathine penicillin G (BPG) prophylaxis) only.

::: notes
Time: 0.75 min (cumulative 2.25). Out of scope: primary prevention, acute rheumatic fever, heart-failure management. Surgery is represented as a background service, equal in both arms. Transition: the burden.
:::

## About `r fmt_f(TOT_PREV / 1e6, 1)` million people live with RHD in the two countries, and `r if (max(dx_share(I), dx_share(U)) < 0.5) "most are undiagnosed in the model" else "the model diagnoses a majority in at least one country"`

\bignumber{`r fmt_f(TOT_PREV / 1e6, 2)` million}{people living with RHD in Indonesia and Uganda, `r I$g_last`}

\medskip

Modelled share of classifiable RHD with a confirmed diagnosis entering `r Y0`: \prov{`r fmt_pct(I$ycut("ref", Y0)$diag / I$ycut("ref", Y0)$sick, 0)`} in Indonesia, \prov{`r fmt_pct(U$ycut("ref", Y0)$diag / U$ycut("ref", Y0)$sick, 0)`} in Uganda; on BPG \prov{`r fmt_pct(I$ycut("ref", Y0)$on_bpg / I$ycut("ref", Y0)$sick, 0)`} and \prov{`r fmt_pct(U$ycut("ref", Y0)$on_bpg / U$ycut("ref", Y0)$sick, 0)`}.

\srcline GBD 2023 RHD prevalence, published counts summed over age and sex (Indonesia `r fmt_n(I$gbd_prev)`; Uganda `r fmt_n(U$gbd_prev)`). Model shares are end-of-`r Y0` reference-arm stocks, grown from provisional initial care shares. Amber marks provisional assumptions throughout.

::: notes
Time: 1.0 min (cumulative 3.25). GBD reports `r fmt_n(I$gbd_deaths)` RHD deaths in Indonesia and `r fmt_n(U$gbd_deaths)` in Uganda in `r I$g_last`. The diagnosed and on-BPG shares are not survey estimates: they come from provisional initial shares in 2000 carried forward under reference care. Transition: what the model builds on.
:::

## The model builds on an established RHD investment case, but its structure and parameters are provisional

:::: columns
::: {.column width="52%"}
**Builds on**

- Investment-case design of @Coates2021: in the African Union, secondary prevention with secondary and tertiary care returned a benefit–cost ratio (BCR) of 4.7 to 2030 <!-- src: Coates2021, summary (manuscript p. 3) -->
- World Heart Federation (WHF) echo stages A–D [@Rwebembera2023]
- GBD 2023 burden; UN World Population Prospects (WPP) 2024
:::
::: {.column width="45%"}
\begin{uncertaintyblock}{Boundary}
\textbf{Deterministic} point estimates; no sensitivity analysis.\\[3pt]
Disease history and first confirmed diagnosis are separated; stage-D-only mortality and a progression effect of SAP are provisional choices.\\[3pt]
`r if (BOTH_FAIL) "The fit fails its tolerances; results are \\textbf{not} a credible baseline yet." else "The fit status differs by country; see the status slide."`
\end{uncertaintyblock}
:::
::::

::: notes
Time: 1.0 min (cumulative 4.25). @Coates2021 report the 4.7 ratio (UI 2.9–6.3). Our model adds a screening-and-confirmation route to first diagnosis and limits prophylaxis to eligible confirmed disease. Projections are model-conditional scenarios, not forecasts. Transition: how the model turns inputs into contrasts.
:::

# How the model works

## Four linked steps turn GBD and WPP inputs into health and economic contrasts

```{=latex}
\begin{center}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\node[deckbox=wbnavy] (gbd)  at (0, 1.35)    {GBD 2023\\RHD and all-cause\\rates, counts};
\node[deckbox=wbnavy] (wpp)  at (0, -0.25)   {UN WPP 2024\\population,\\age $\times$ sex};
\node[deckbox=wbblue] (l1)   at (2.85, 1.35) {Layer 1 proxy\\start values\\for incidence};
\node[deckbox=wbblue] (l2)   at (2.85, -0.25){Layer 2 joint fit\\incidence and six\\transitions};
\node[deckbox=wbblue] (base) at (5.7, 0.55)  {Bridge to `r Y0`\\full engine state\\carried forward};
\node[deckbox=comparatorgrey] (ref) at (8.5, 1.35)  {Reference arm\\care held\\at baseline};
\node[deckbox=wbblue] (sap)  at (8.5, -0.25) {Scale-up arm\\screening, BPG\\ramp to targets};
\node[deckbox=phcol]  (hlth) at (11.3, 1.35) {Health and\\service outputs\\deaths, volumes};
\node[deckbox=phcol]  (econ) at (11.3, -0.25){Economic\\evaluation\\costs, BCR};
\node[deckwide] (lit) at (6.95, -1.75) {Assumptions: transition centres and bounds $\cdot$ fixed D mortality $\cdot$ entry mixes $\cdot$ assumed SAP progression multiplier $\cdot$ care inputs $\cdot$ unit costs $\cdot$ VSL};
\draw[deckarrow] (gbd) -- (l1);
\draw[deckarrow] (gbd) -- (l2);
\draw[deckarrow] (wpp) -- (l2);
\draw[deckarrow] (l1) -- node[decklab, right] {start} (l2);
\draw[deckarrow] (l2) -- (base);
\draw[deckarrow] (base) -- (ref);
\draw[deckarrow] (base) -- (sap);
\draw[deckarrow] (ref) -- (hlth);
\draw[deckarrow] (sap) -- (hlth);
\draw[deckarrow] (hlth) -- (econ);
\draw[deckarrow] (lit.north -| l2) -- (l2);
\draw[deckarrow] (lit.north -| sap) -- (sap);
\draw[deckarrow] (lit.north -| econ) -- (econ);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{center}
```

\srcline GBD supplies the targets; WPP the population. Layer 2, the bridge and both arms run one annual engine (`r gsub("_", "\\\\_", ENGINE)`). SAP: secondary antibiotic prophylaxis. VSL: value of a statistical life.

::: notes
Time: 1.25 min (cumulative 5.5). Layer 1 is an aggregate proxy whose incidence multipliers only start the Layer-2 search. Layer 2 fits incidence corrections and six transitions with the production engine; stage-D mortality is fixed, not fitted. The calibrated `r CY` state, including diagnosis, BPG and screening histories, is carried through the bridge to `r Y0` without reseeding. The arms differ only in care. Transition: the state map.
:::

## New disease enters A before age `r BAGE + 1` and B after; screening finds it, and only stage D dies of RHD

```{r state-diagram, results = "asis"}
# Drawn from the saved specification (entry mixes, age convention, D-only, D->C = 0).
le <- sprintf("$\\leq$%d", BAGE); gt <- sprintf("$>$%d", BAGE)
tk <- c("\\begin{center}\\begin{tikzpicture}",
  "\\node[deckbox=comparatorgrey, text width=1.7cm] (N) at (0,0) {Never-onset\\\\(no disease)};",
  "\\node[deckbox=wbblue, text width=1.5cm] (A) at (2.7,0) {A\\\\minimal};",
  "\\node[deckbox=wbblue, text width=1.5cm] (B) at (5.1,0) {B\\\\mild};",
  "\\node[deckbox=wbblue, text width=1.5cm] (C) at (7.5,0) {C\\\\advanced};",
  "\\node[deckbox=casefatalcol, text width=1.5cm] (D) at (9.9,0) {D\\\\complicated};",
  "\\node[deckbox=wbnavy, text width=1.4cm] (X) at (12.3,0) {RHD\\\\death};",
  "\\node[deckbox=uwpurple, text width=2.1cm, minimum height=0.85cm] (P) at (3.9,1.8) {Adult prior-A\\\\(not prevalence)};",
  "\\node[deckbox=phcol, text width=2.1cm, minimum height=0.85cm] (R) at (3.9,-1.7) {Normalised\\\\history};",
  sprintf("\\draw[deckarrow] (N) -- node[decklab, below=2pt] {%s} (A);", le),
  sprintf("\\draw[deckarrow] (N.north) to[out=60, in=150] node[decklab, above, pos=0.12] {%s} (B.north west);", gt),
  "\\draw[deckarrow] (A) -- (B);", "\\draw[deckarrow] (B) -- (C);", "\\draw[deckarrow] (C) -- (D);",
  "\\draw[deckarrow, draw=casefatalcol] (D) -- node[decklab, above] {$m_D$} (X);",
  sprintf("\\draw[deckarrow, dashed, draw=uwpurple] (A.north) -- node[decklab, left, text=uwpurple] {age %d} (P.south west);", BAGE + 1L),
  "\\draw[deckarrow, dashed, draw=uwpurple] (P.south east) -- node[decklab, right, text=uwpurple] {re-entry} (B.north);",
  sprintf("\\draw[deckarrow, dashed, draw=phcol] (A.south) -- node[decklab, left, text=phcol] {%s} (R.north west);", le),
  sprintf("\\draw[deckarrow, dashed, draw=phcol] (B.south) -- node[decklab, right, text=phcol] {%s} (R.north east);", gt),
  sprintf("\\node[deckwide, draw=wbblue, fill=wbblue!6, text width=5.6cm] at (9.6,-1.7) {Each stage A--D: undiagnosed (never / ever screened) $\\rightarrow$ first confirmed diagnosis $\\rightarrow$ off BPG $\\leftrightarrow$ on BPG (A %s, B)};", le),
  sprintf("\\node[decklab] at (6.15,-2.6) {Regression C$\\rightarrow$B and B$\\rightarrow$A at ages %s; other-cause death from every state; D$\\rightarrow$C fixed at 0};", le),
  "\\end{tikzpicture}\\end{center}")
cat(tk, sep = "\n")
```

\srcline Drawn from the saved specification: new disease enters `r ENTRY_CH` at ages $\leq `r BAGE`$ and `r ENTRY_AD` above. Ages are attained ages; the boundary is a modelling convention, not a WHF rule. Surgery is a service on C$\rightarrow$D and D death, not a state.

::: notes
Time: 1.5 min (cumulative 7.0). New modelled disease enters A at ages up to `r BAGE` and B above `r BAGE`; these entry mixes are simplifying assumptions, not estimates of onset age. At the `r BAGE`-to-`r BAGE + 1` ageing step surviving A becomes adult prior-A: lesion history excluded from classifiable prevalence and from SAP, which can re-enter B. Normalised people keep a history stock with no recurrence. Rules depend on attained age only, never on when diagnosis happened. Transition: the care split inside each stage.
:::

## Every stage is split by care status, and only some stocks count as prevalence or receive SAP

```{r tab-care-states}
cs_tab <- data.frame(
  Stock = c("Undiagnosed, never screened", "Undiagnosed, screened (missed / unconfirmed)", "Confirmed, not on BPG",
            "Confirmed, on BPG", paste0("Adult prior-A (age $>$", BAGE, ")"), "Normalised history", "Never-onset"),
  Stages = c("A--D", "A--D", "A--D", paste0("A ($\\leq$", BAGE, "), B"), "--", "--", "--"),
  Prev = c("Yes", "Yes", "Yes", "Yes", "\\prov{No}", "No", "No"),
  SAP = c("No", "No", paste0("Eligible if A ($\\leq$", BAGE, ") or B"), "Yes", "No", "No", "No"),
  Screened = c("Yes", "No (one screen)", "No", "No", "If never screened", "If never screened", "If never screened"))
names(cs_tab) <- c("Stock", "Stages", "Prevalence", "SAP", "Screenable")
kb(cs_tab, "lllll", widths = c("4.4cm", "1.6cm", "1.5cm", "2.4cm", "2.1cm"), font = 8)
```

\srcline Classifiable RHD (GBD prevalence mapping) = undiagnosed + diagnosed in A--D; RHD deaths come from diagnosed and undiagnosed D. A first confirmed diagnosis happens once; nobody returns to undiagnosed.

::: notes
Time: 1.0 min (cumulative 8.0). Screening finds existing disease; it never creates disease. Confirmation failure leaves disease undiagnosed. C and D have no SAP programme volume in this simplified default. Prior-A previously diagnosed re-enters the diagnosed cohort, so no repeat first diagnosis is counted. Transition: the transition rules by age.
:::

## Six childhood transitions are calibrated; adult B$\rightarrow$C and C$\rightarrow$D run at `r fmt_f(M_AD)` times the childhood hazard

```{r tab-age-rules}
v <- function(r, p) fmt_f(r$tr[[p]], 3)
va <- function(r, p, a) paste0(fmt_f(r$tr[[p]], 3), " / ", fmt_f(a, 3))   # childhood / adult
ar_tab <- data.frame(
  T = c("A $\\rightarrow$ normalised", "A $\\rightarrow$ B (adult: prior-A $\\rightarrow$ B)", "B $\\rightarrow$ A",
        "B $\\rightarrow$ C (child / adult)", "C $\\rightarrow$ B", "C $\\rightarrow$ D (child / adult)",
        "Adult progression hazard multiplier $m$", "B $\\rightarrow$ normalised", "D $\\rightarrow$ RHD death"),
  ch = c("calibrated", "calibrated", "calibrated", "calibrated", "calibrated", "calibrated", "--", "0", "\\prov{fixed}"),
  ad = c("0", "same value", "0", "hazard $\\times\\,m$", "0", "hazard $\\times\\,m$", "\\prov{fixed}", "\\prov{fixed}", "\\prov{fixed}"),
  i = c(v(I, "p_A_to_no_rhd"), v(I, "p_A_to_B"), v(I, "p_B_to_A"), va(I, "p_B_to_C", I$bc_ad), v(I, "p_C_to_B"),
        va(I, "p_C_to_D", I$cd_ad), fmt_f(I$m_ad, 2), fmt_f(I$nh$p_B_to_no_rhd_adult, 3), fmt_f(I$nh$p_rhd_death_D, 3)),
  u = c(v(U, "p_A_to_no_rhd"), v(U, "p_A_to_B"), v(U, "p_B_to_A"), va(U, "p_B_to_C", U$bc_ad), v(U, "p_C_to_B"),
        va(U, "p_C_to_D", U$cd_ad), fmt_f(U$m_ad, 2), fmt_f(U$nh$p_B_to_no_rhd_adult, 3), fmt_f(U$nh$p_rhd_death_D, 3)))
names(ar_tab) <- c("Annual probability", paste0("Age $\\leq$", BAGE), paste0("Age $>$", BAGE), "Indonesia", "Uganda")
kb(ar_tab, "lllrr", widths = c("4.3cm", "1.6cm", "1.8cm", "1.9cm", "1.9cm"), font = 9)
```

\srcline Values in force (calibrated or fixed). Adult B$\rightarrow$C and C$\rightarrow$D: $p_{\text{adult}} = 1-(1-p_{\text{child}})^m$, every disease and diagnosis history; age `r BAGE` uses the childhood values. Annual probabilities are converted once to hazards. A$\rightarrow$C, A/B/C RHD death and D$\rightarrow$C are exact zeros. The late-entry D-death multiplier is removed (value 1).

::: notes
Time: 1.25 min (cumulative 9.25). Stage-D mortality is a fixed country input (`r fmt_f(I$nh$p_rhd_death_D, 3)` Indonesia, `r fmt_f(U$nh$p_rhd_death_D, 3)` Uganda), not fitted. Adult B normalisation `r fmt_f(I$nh$p_B_to_no_rhd_adult, 2)` is a fixed provisional extrapolation. The adult multiplier `r fmt_f(M_AD)` is a fixed provisional reference value, not estimated, and the same in both countries; it scales hazards, never probabilities directly. Because the calibrated values are the childhood ones, the refit can raise the childhood rates and offset part of the adult reduction. Transition: how the boundary at age `r BAGE + 1` works.
:::

## At age `r BAGE + 1`, surviving A becomes prior-A: about `r fmt_h(I$ycut("ref", Y0)$reclass)` people a year in Indonesia, `r fmt_h(U$ycut("ref", Y0)$reclass)` in Uganda

```{r tab-boundary}
bd <- function(r) { a <- r$ycut("ref", Y0)
  c(fmt_n(a$newcases), fmt_n(a$reclass), fmt_n(a$reentry), fmt_n(a$prior_A), fmt_n(a$normalised)) }
bd_tab <- data.frame(q = c(paste0("New modelled disease (A $\\leq$", BAGE, ", B $>$", BAGE, ")"),
                           paste0("A reclassified to prior-A at ", BAGE + 1),
                           "Prior-A re-entering B", "Adult prior-A stock (end of year)", "Normalised history stock (end of year)"),
                     i = bd(I), u = bd(U))
names(bd_tab) <- c(paste0("Reference arm, ", Y0), "Indonesia", "Uganda")
kb(bd_tab, "lrr", widths = c("7.4cm", "2.6cm", "2.6cm"))
```

\srcline New disease is not diagnosis. Re-entry from prior-A is tracked separately from first entry and from first diagnosis.

::: notes
Time: 1.0 min (cumulative 10.25). The reclassification conserves people: nobody dies or is dropped; the lesion simply stops counting as classifiable RHD. That design choice produces a visible drop in modelled prevalence between ages `r BAGE` and `r BAGE + 1`, which GBD does not show. Transition: the competing-risk arithmetic.
:::

## Competing exits are split on the hazard scale, so every stock balances exactly

Each state faces several annual risks at once; converting them to hazards keeps every outflow non-negative.

$$
p_{s\to e}=\Big(1-e^{-H_s}\Big)\,\textcolor{wbblue}{\frac{h_e}{H_s}},\qquad
h_e=-\ln\left(1-p_e\right),\qquad H_s=\sum_{e\in\mathcal{E}_s} h_e
$$

State $s$ keeps the share $e^{-H_s}$. For stage B at age $> `r BAGE`$: to C, to normalised, other-cause death (its RHD-death hazard is exactly zero). All probabilities are per year.

::: notes
Time: 0.5 min (cumulative 10.75). No clipping is needed; outflows plus the stay share sum to one. The same function runs in calibration, the bridge and the projection. Transition: the order within one year.
:::

## Each year reconciles the population, updates care, applies exits, adds new disease, then ages everyone

1. Stocks enter year $t$ already aged; never-onset and normalised pools absorb WPP births and migration
2. Care update: screening, confirmation, clinical detection, BPG retention and initiation
3. Competing exits split on the hazard scale; on-BPG people get the SAP hazard multipliers
4. New modelled disease from the never-onset pool joins A ($\leq `r BAGE`$) or B ($> `r BAGE`$) at year end
5. Survivors age one year; surviving A at `r BAGE` becomes prior-A; 100+ is open

\srcline Disease and prior-A stocks are never rescaled. New disease first faces stage hazards the next year. Prevalence is observed as `r switch(I$prev_obs, mid = "the mean of the start and end stocks", start = "the start stock", end = "the end stock")`.

::: notes
Time: 0.75 min (cumulative 11.5). Population is exogenous: WPP fixes each age-sex cell. Background deaths are GBD all-cause minus RHD. Transition: how first diagnoses arise.
:::

## A first confirmed diagnosis needs a screen, a true positive and a completed confirmation — or clinical detection

$$
\text{dx}^{\text{scr}}_t=q_t\,\textcolor{wbblue}{s\,\kappa\,\phi}\,U^{\text{ns}}_t,\qquad
q_t=1-(1-c_t)^{1/`r W_SCR`},\qquad
\text{dx}^{\text{clin}}_t=k\,\big(U_t-\text{dx}^{\text{scr}}_t\big)
$$

$U^{\text{ns}}$: undiagnosed, never screened; $c_t$: probability of one screen across ages `r I$cv$constants$screen_age_lo`--`r I$cv$constants$screen_age_hi`; sensitivity $s$ = `r fmt_f(I$cv$constants$sensitivity)`, confirmation completion $\kappa$ = \prov{`r fmt_f(I$cv$constants$confirm_completion)`}, confirmation sensitivity $\phi$ = `r fmt_f(I$cv$constants$confirm_sensitivity)`; clinical detection $k$ = \prov{`r fmt_f(I$cv$ref$clinical_detection[1])`}. Screening encounters $= q_t\times$ never-screened people without a prior diagnosis.

\srcline Perfect specificity assumed (no false positives). Window target $c$: reference \prov{`r fmt_cov(I$cv$ref$screen_window_prob[1])`} (Indonesia), \prov{`r fmt_cov(U$cv$ref$screen_window_prob[1])`} (Uganda); scale-up `r fmt_cov(max(I$cv$sap$screen_window_prob))` by `r YE` ($q$ = `r fmt_f(q_of(max(I$cv$sap$screen_window_prob)), 3)` a year).

::: notes
Time: 1.25 min (cumulative 12.75). One screen per person: people screened but missed stay undiagnosed and are not screened again. Clinical detection continues at every age and is not multiplied by the screening confirmation factor. In the reference arm clinical detection dominates first diagnoses. Transition: what happens after diagnosis.
:::

## SAP is assumed to cut A$\rightarrow$B and B$\rightarrow$C hazards by `r fmt_pct(RRR_SAP)` on BPG below age `r AMAX + 1L`: an expert-informed scenario, not an estimate

```{r tab-sap}
sap_tab <- data.frame(
  q = c("Eligibility (unchanged)", "BPG initiation (diagnosed, off BPG)", "BPG retention (annual)", "Adherence: good / partial share",
        paste0("Protection factor $a$ (good + ", fmt_f(I$cv$constants$partial_relative_protection, 1), " $\\times$ partial)"),
        paste0("Assumed multiplier $M$ (full adherence), A$\\rightarrow$B and B$\\rightarrow$C, age $\\leq$", AMAX),
        paste0("On-BPG multiplier $1-a(1-M)$, age $\\leq$", AMAX),
        paste0("Age $\\geq$", AMAX + 1L, "; C$\\rightarrow$D; D death")),
  r = c(paste0("A ($\\leq$", BAGE, "), B; not C/D"), fmt_cov(I$cv$ref$bpg_initiation[1]), fmt_cov(I$cv$ref$bpg_retention[1]),
        paste0(fmt_cov(I$cv$ref$adherence_good[1]), " / ", fmt_cov(I$cv$ref$adherence_partial[1])), fmt_f(I$adh("ref", 1)),
        paste0("\\prov{", fmt_f(M_SAP, 2), "}"), fmt_f(eff_m(I$adh("ref", 1)), 3),
        paste0(fmt_f(I$hr[["C_to_D"]], 0), " (no modelled effect)")),
  s = c("same", fmt_cov(max(I$cv$sap$bpg_initiation)), fmt_cov(max(I$cv$sap$bpg_retention)),
        paste0(fmt_cov(max(I$cv$sap$adherence_good)), " / ", fmt_cov(I$cv$sap$adherence_partial[length(I$yy)])),
        fmt_f(I$adh("sap", length(I$yy))), "same", fmt_f(eff_m(I$adh("sap", length(I$yy))), 3), "same"))
names(sap_tab) <- c("", "Reference", paste0("Scale-up (", YE, ")"))
kb(sap_tab, "lrr", widths = c("6.8cm", "2.9cm", "2.9cm"), font = 8)
```

\srcline Default: `r SAP_LABEL`. Manyemba et al. (Cochrane, PMID 12137650): RR `r fmt_f(EV_RR, 2)` for recurrent RF (`r fmt_pct(1 - EV_RR)` RRR), one trial; not a HR, not valve progression; $M$ \prov{assumed}. $h=h_0[1-a(1-M)]$; illustrative $a$ = `r fmt_f(A_ILLUS, 2)`: `r fmt_f(eff_m(A_ILLUS), 3)`. GOAL child HRs: documented alternative.

::: notes
Time: 1.25 min (cumulative 14.0). Four separate decisions. Effect: an assumed full-adherence multiplier of `r fmt_f(M_SAP, 2)` on A to B and B to C only; the published 0.45 is a risk ratio for recurrent rheumatic fever, so applying it to valve progression is an expert-informed assumption. Benefit age: attained age `r AMAX` or below, independent of the age-`r BAGE` natural-history boundary. Eligibility and duration are unchanged: A at `r BAGE` or below and B, no new age stop for B, existing dropout, and A becomes prior-A at `r BAGE + 1`; C and D are not eligible. Stage B people aged `r AMAX + 1L` and over stay on BPG and are costed but get no modelled benefit. Adherence: the reference weight `r fmt_f(I$adh("ref", 1), 2)` gives `r fmt_f(eff_m(I$adh("ref", 1)), 3)`; the `r fmt_f(A_ILLUS, 2)` example is illustrative. No direct effect on mortality or incidence. Transition: the full input list.
:::

## Observed data anchor demography and burden; stage dynamics and care are calibrated or assumed

```{r tab-inputs-1}
in1 <- data.frame(
  Input = c("Population", "Prevalence, deaths", "Background deaths", "RHD incidence", "Six transitions", "Stage-D mortality",
            "Entry mixes, adult normalisation", "Initial diagnosed / on-BPG share", "Incidence trend"),
  Source = c("UN WPP 2024", if (identical(I$basis, "number")) "GBD 2023 counts" else "GBD rate $\\times$ WPP",
             "GBD all-cause $-$ RHD", "GBD $\\times$ Layer-2 $\\alpha$", "Layer 2 within bounds",
             paste0(fmt_f(I$nh$p_rhd_death_D, 3), " / ", fmt_f(U$nh$p_rhd_death_D, 4)), "Modelling assumption",
             paste0(fmt_cov(I$cv$init$diagnosed_share), " / ", fmt_cov(I$cv$init$on_bpg_share), " (Indonesia)"), "Assumption"),
  Status = c("Observed", "Observed", "Observed", "Calibrated", "\\prov{Partly identified}", "\\prov{Fixed, provisional}",
             "\\prov{Fixed, new}", "\\prov{Provisional}", "\\prov{Provisional}"))
kb(in1, "lll", widths = c("4.6cm", "5.0cm", "3.2cm"), font = 9)
```

::: notes
Time: 0.75 min (cumulative 14.75). Incidence is estimated but not fitted directly (weight `r fmt_f(I$oc$weights[["W_INC"]], 1)`): GBD incidence is validation. Uganda's initial shares are `r fmt_cov(U$cv$init$diagnosed_share)` diagnosed and `r fmt_cov(U$cv$init$on_bpg_share)` on BPG. Transition: costs and valuation.
:::

## Costs price screening encounters and BPG person-years; confirmation is not priced

```{r tab-inputs-2}
in2 <- data.frame(
  Input = c("Screening encounter", "Confirmatory echo", "BPG (SAP) person-year", "Valve surgery",
            paste0("GNI per capita, PPP, ", VA$income_anchor_year), paste0("VSL in ", Y0, "; discount rate")),
  i = c(fmt_usd(I$ep$cost_screen_per_person, 2), "\\prov{not costed}", fmt_usd(I$ep$cost_sap_per_year), fmt_usd(I$ep$cost_surgery),
        fmt_int(I$va$income_target_Y), paste0(fmt_usd(round(I$vsl0, -3)), "; ", fmt_pct(I$ep$disc_rate))),
  u = c(fmt_usd(U$ep$cost_screen_per_person, 2), "\\prov{not costed}", fmt_usd(U$ep$cost_sap_per_year), fmt_usd(U$ep$cost_surgery),
        fmt_int(U$va$income_target_Y), paste0(fmt_usd(round(U$vsl0, -3)), "; ", fmt_pct(U$ep$disc_rate))),
  Status = c("\\prov{Undocumented}", "\\prov{Omitted}", "\\prov{Undocumented}", "\\prov{Undocumented}",
             paste0("World Bank WDI, ", VA$income_anchor_year), "Reference case"))
names(in2) <- c(paste0("Input (", LB$price_year, " US\\$)"), "Indonesia", "Uganda", "Status")
kb(in2, "lrrl", widths = c("4.0cm", "2.3cm", "2.3cm", "2.8cm"), font = 9)
```

\srcline Volumes come from the engine: encounters, on-BPG person-years (A $\leq `r BAGE`$ and B), surgeries. Unit-cost sources are not recorded; price year assumed 2019, converted to `r CUR` with each country's CPI and exchange rates (factor `r fmt_f(I$pfac, 3)` Indonesia, `r fmt_f(U$pfac, 3)` Uganda). Total cost is understated by the confirmation cost.

::: notes
Time: 0.75 min (cumulative 15.5). Surgery is held equal in both arms, so it shapes levels but contributes little to the incremental cost. VSL follows the reference-case default: the U.S. value is transferred by PPP GNI per capita with an income elasticity of `r fmt_f(EL, 1)`, floored at `r FL` times GNI per capita, and grows with real income at the same elasticity; no separate GDP benefit. Transition: the calibration.
:::

# How the model was calibrated

## Layer 2 fits prevalence `r fmt_f(I$oc$prev_death_ratio, 1)` times as heavily as deaths, with child and adult components weighted equally

:::: columns
::: {.column width="47%"}
**Layer 1: aggregate proxy** (`r I$cal$meta$calib_year_start`–`r I$cal$meta$calib_year_end`)

- Well–sick–dead proxy; GBD counts
- Weights incidence / prevalence / deaths `r paste(I$cal$layer1$optimizer_diagnostics$weights, collapse = " / ")`
- Role: \prov{start values only}
:::
::: {.column width="51%"}
**Layer 2: production engine** (scored `r MF`–`r CY`)

- Prevalence `r fmt_f(I$oc$weights[["W_PREV"]], 1)`, deaths `r fmt_f(I$oc$weights[["W_DEATH"]], 1)`, incidence `r fmt_f(I$oc$weights[["W_INC"]], 1)`
- Each split 0–19 / 20+ at `r fmt_f(I$oc$weights[["prev_child_share"]], 1)` / `r fmt_f(1 - I$oc$weights[["prev_child_share"]], 1)`
- Free: 6 childhood transitions + `r sum(grepl("^alpha", I$ptab$parameter))` incidence $\alpha$
- Adult B$\rightarrow$C, C$\rightarrow$D: hazard $\times$ \prov{`r fmt_f(M_AD)`} (fixed)
- Burn-in `r I$sc$priors$burn_years` cycles, per-capita balanced
:::
::::

\srcline Targets: `r basis_label`; prevalence = classifiable RHD (diagnosed + undiagnosed), prior-A and normalised excluded. Prior weight $\lambda$ = `r fmt_f(I$oc$lambda_prior_structural, 2)`.

::: notes
Time: 1.0 min (cumulative 16.5). Each component is a normalised mean log error over its own cells, so a larger grid or tiny death cells cannot dominate. Reference care runs inside the objective, so fitted transitions are untreated natural history. Years `r I$cal$meta$calib_year_start`–`r MF - 1L` are projected but not scored. Transition: how well it fits.
:::

## Deaths are `r rng(dratio(I))` times GBD in Indonesia and `r rng(dratio(U))` in Uganda across `r MF`–`r CY`; `r if (!ALL_TOL_ANY(I) && !ALL_TOL_ANY(U)) "no checkpoint quantity is in tolerance in every year" else "some checkpoint quantities are in tolerance in every year"`

```{r tab-fit}
qs <- c("prevalence, all ages", "prevalence, ages 20+", "RHD deaths, all ages", "RHD deaths, ages 0-19", "RHD deaths, ages 20+",
        "prevalence, ages 0-19", "incidence (validation)")
ql <- c("Prevalence, all ages", "Prevalence, 20+", "RHD deaths, all ages", "RHD deaths, 0--19", "RHD deaths, 20+",
        "Prevalence, 0--19 (diagnostic)", "Incidence (validation)")
cellr <- function(r, q) { x <- r$tol[quantity == q]
  if (!nrow(x)) return(c("--", "--"))
  c(rng(x), if (is.na(x$tol)) "--" else paste0(x$years_within, "/", x$years_scored)) }
fi <- t(vapply(qs, function(q) cellr(I, q), c("", ""))); fu <- t(vapply(qs, function(q) cellr(U, q), c("", "")))
fit_tab <- data.frame(Q = ql, a = fi[, 1], b = fi[, 2], c = fu[, 1], d = fu[, 2])
names(fit_tab) <- c("Model / GBD target", "Ratio range", "Yrs in tol.", "Ratio range", "Yrs in tol.")
kb(fit_tab, "lrrrr", widths = c("4.4cm", "2.0cm", "1.4cm", "2.0cm", "1.4cm"), font = 9) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Indonesia" = 2, "Uganda" = 2))
```

\srcline Ratios over the scored years, both sexes, `r basis_label`. Tolerance |log ratio| $<$ `r fmt_f(I$sc$spec$fit_tolerances[["prevalence"]])` (prevalence) and `r fmt_f(I$sc$spec$fit_tolerances[["deaths"]])` (deaths) in every year. Ratios to published GBD counts are in backup.

::: notes
Time: 1.25 min (cumulative 17.75). The tolerances are operational criteria, not external validation. Indonesia reproduces childhood prevalence but only `r fmt_pct(I$tol[quantity == "RHD deaths, ages 0-19", ratio_max], 0)` of childhood deaths at best, while adult deaths are `r rng(d20(I))` times GBD even with the adult multiplier. Uganda is closer: its all-age deaths are within tolerance in `r dratio(U)$years_within` of `r dratio(U)$years_scored` scored years, adult deaths `r rng(d20(U))` times GBD, and prevalence stays low (`r rng(pratio(U))`). Parameters at a bound: `r hits(I)` (Indonesia), `r hits(U)` (Uganda). Transition: the pattern over time.
:::

## Over `r MF`–`r CY` `r if (DRIFT_UP) "the death ratios rise while GBD deaths per prevalent case fall" else "the model / GBD ratios change across the scored years"`

```{r fig-fit-year, fig.height = 2.3}
fyd <- rbindlist(lapply(COUNTRIES, function(ct) R[[ct]]$fy[measure %in% c("Prevalence", "Prevalence 20+", "Deaths", "Deaths 0-19", "Deaths 20+"),
                                                           .(country = ct, measure, year, ratio)]))
fyd[, kind := fifelse(grepl("^Prev", measure), "Prevalence", "Deaths")]
fyd[, series := factor(measure, levels = c("Prevalence", "Prevalence 20+", "Deaths", "Deaths 0-19", "Deaths 20+"),
                       labels = c("all", "20+", "all", "0-19", "20+"))]
fyd[, panel := factor(paste0(country, ": ", tolower(kind)), levels = paste0(rep(COUNTRIES, each = 2), ": ", c("prevalence", "deaths")))]
band <- unique(fyd[, .(panel, kind)])[, `:=`(lo = exp(-fifelse(kind == "Prevalence", I$sc$spec$fit_tolerances[["prevalence"]], I$sc$spec$fit_tolerances[["deaths"]])),
                                          hi = exp(fifelse(kind == "Prevalence", I$sc$spec$fit_tolerances[["prevalence"]], I$sc$spec$fit_tolerances[["deaths"]])))]
lab <- fyd[year == max(year)]
ggplot(fyd, aes(year, ratio, colour = series)) +
  geom_rect(data = band, aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = lo, ymax = hi), inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = col_gbd, alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = MF - 0.5, colour = "grey55", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "22", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = lab, aes(label = series), hjust = -0.1, family = "Calibri", size = 2.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("all" = col_ref, "20+" = col_sap, "0-19" = col_prov)) +
  scale_y_log10() + scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2000, MF, CY), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.3))) +
  theme_deck + theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 9))
```

\srcline Model / GBD target by year, log scale. Green band: tolerance; dotted line: start of the scored years. GBD deaths per prevalent case change `r fmt_pct(I$mech$gbd_cf_change)` (Indonesia) and `r fmt_pct(U$mech$gbd_cf_change)` (Uganda) from `r MF` to `r CY`.

::: notes
Time: 1.0 min (cumulative 18.75). GBD deaths fall while prevalence rises, so its case fatality declines. The model has constant natural history and flat reference care, so its death ratio drifts up by `r fmt_pct(I$mech$death_drift)` (Indonesia) and `r fmt_pct(U$mech$death_drift)` (Uganda) across the scored years. That drift alone uses most of the tolerance band. Transition: the age pattern.
:::

## By age, `r if (DIP) "prevalence dips at 20–24, where prior-A leaves the count, and adult deaths are above GBD" else "the fit varies across age groups"`

```{r fig-fit-age, fig.height = 2.25}
fa <- rbindlist(lapply(COUNTRIES, function(ct) { r <- R[[ct]]
  r$fl[year == r$cy & measure %in% c("Prevalence", "Deaths"),
       .(ratio = sum(model) / sum(target_used, na.rm = TRUE), glo = glo[1]), by = .(measure, age_group)][, country := ct] }))
fa <- fa[is.finite(ratio) & ratio > 0]
fa[, panel := factor(paste(country, tolower(measure)), levels = paste(rep(COUNTRIES, each = 2), c("prevalence", "deaths")))]
ggplot(fa, aes(glo + 2.5, ratio)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "22", colour = "grey50") +

  geom_line(colour = "grey70") +
  geom_point(colour = col_sap, size = 1.4) +
```

\srcline Model / GBD target by GBD age group, `r CY`, both sexes, log scale. Purple dotted lines: ages 20--24. Prevalence at 20--24 is `r fmt_f(I$mech$prev_2024)` (Indonesia) and `r fmt_f(U$mech$prev_2024)` (Uganda) times GBD.

::: notes
Time: 1.0 min (cumulative 19.75). The 20–24 dip is a direct consequence of excluding adult prior-A from prevalence while child A counts. Indonesia's adult deaths are highest relative to GBD at `r gsub(" years", "", peak_grp(I)$age_group)` (`r fmt_f(peak_grp(I)$ratio, 1)` times). Uganda's prevalence at 60+ is `r fmt_f(U$mech$prev_60p)` times GBD, because adults leave B only through normalisation or progression. Transition: the parameters behind this fit.
:::

## `r if (identical(hits(I), "none") && identical(hits(U), "none")) "No calibrated transition sits at a bound" else paste0("Calibrated transitions hit their bounds: ", hits(I), " (Indonesia); ", hits(U), " (Uganda)")`

```{r tab-params}
prow <- function(r, p) { x <- r$ptab[parameter == p]
  b <- if (isTRUE(x$at_lower) || isTRUE(x$at_upper)) "\\prov{\\textbf{" else ""
  c(paste0(fmt_f(x$prior_center, 3), " [", fmt_f(x$bound_lo, 3), ", ", fmt_f(x$bound_hi, 2), "]"),
    paste0(b, fmt_f(x$value, 4), if (nzchar(b)) "}}" else "")) }
cal6 <- tp_rows[1:6]
pi_ <- t(vapply(cal6, function(p) prow(I, p), c("", ""))); pu_ <- t(vapply(cal6, function(p) prow(U, p), c("", "")))
par_tab <- data.frame(Parameter = unname(tp_lab[cal6]), pi = pi_[, 1], vi = pi_[, 2], vu = pu_[, 2])
par_tab <- rbind(par_tab, data.frame(
  Parameter = paste0(c("B $\\rightarrow$ C", "C $\\rightarrow$ D"), ", age $>$", BAGE, " (derived)"),
  pi = paste0("hazard $\\times$ ", fmt_f(M_AD)), vi = fmt_f(c(I$bc_ad, I$cd_ad), 4), vu = fmt_f(c(U$bc_ad, U$cd_ad), 4)))
names(par_tab) <- c("Annual probability", "Centre [bounds]", "Indonesia", "Uganda")
kb(par_tab, "lrrr", widths = c("3.8cm", "3.4cm", "2.2cm", "2.2cm"), font = 9)
```

\srcline Amber bold: at a bound. Incidence multipliers: `r fmt_f(min(I$bp$incidence_alpha$alpha))`--`r fmt_f(max(I$bp$incidence_alpha$alpha))` (Indonesia), `r fmt_f(min(U$bp$incidence_alpha$alpha))`--`r fmt_f(max(U$bp$incidence_alpha$alpha))` (Uganda). Calibrated rows are childhood values. Fixed: D death, adult B normalisation, adult progression multiplier `r fmt_f(M_AD)`, entry mixes, D$\rightarrow$C = 0.

::: notes
Time: 1.0 min (cumulative 20.75). Bound hits: `r hits(I)` in Indonesia, `r hits(U)` in Uganda; the optimiser pushes childhood progression up to create childhood deaths. With adult hazards fixed at `r fmt_f(M_AD)` times the childhood values, Indonesia's adult C to D is `r fmt_f(I$cd_ad, 3)` against a childhood `r fmt_f(I$tr$p_C_to_D, 3)`, but childhood B to C rises to `r fmt_f(I$tr$p_B_to_C, 3)`, so adult B to C stays at `r fmt_f(I$bc_ad, 3)`. Uganda's childhood B to C is `r fmt_f(U$tr$p_B_to_C, 4)` (adult `r fmt_f(U$bc_ad, 4)`), and incidence is scaled down to `r fmt_f(min(U$bp$incidence_alpha$alpha))`–`r fmt_f(max(U$bp$incidence_alpha$alpha))`. All `r nrow(as.data.table(I$sc$convergence))` starts converged per country. Transition: stage D.
:::

## Stage D holds `r fmt_pct(I$eda$stage_shares_last[["D"]], 0)` of Indonesia's modelled RHD against a GBD heart-failure proxy of `r fmt_pct(I$eda$d_share_proxy_gbd_hf, 1)`

```{r tab-stage-d}
sd_tab <- data.frame(
  q = c("Stage-D annual RHD death probability (fixed input)", paste0("Realised D death risk, ", CY),
        paste0("Stage-D share of classifiable RHD, ", CY), "GBD heart-failure proxy share (diagnostic)",
        paste0("Model / GBD RHD deaths per prevalent case, ", CY)),
  i = c(fmt_pct(I$nh$p_rhd_death_D, 1), fmt_pct(I$dfa$realized_D_death_risk, 1), fmt_pct(I$eda$stage_shares_last[["D"]], 1),
        fmt_pct(I$eda$d_share_proxy_gbd_hf, 1), fmt_f(I$eda$cf_implied / I$eda$gbd_cf, 1)),
  u = c(fmt_pct(U$nh$p_rhd_death_D, 1), fmt_pct(U$dfa$realized_D_death_risk, 1), fmt_pct(U$eda$stage_shares_last[["D"]], 1),
        fmt_pct(U$eda$d_share_proxy_gbd_hf, 1), fmt_f(U$eda$cf_implied / U$eda$gbd_cf, 1)))
names(sd_tab) <- c("", "Indonesia", "Uganda")
kb(sd_tab, "lrr", widths = c("7.4cm", "2.5cm", "2.5cm"))
```

\srcline D mortality is the same for every disease and diagnosis history (the former late-entry multiplier of 2 is removed). Realised risk is lower because of competing other-cause death and reference surgery.

::: notes
Time: 0.75 min (cumulative 21.5). Adult deaths changed without touching D mortality: with no direct C or D entry, deaths come only through progression, and adult C to D (the childhood rate scaled by the `r fmt_f(M_AD)` hazard multiplier) drives adult D inflow. The heart-failure proxy is not a validated stage target. Transition: why the fit fails.
:::

## Four mechanisms limit the fit under the fixed assumptions

```{r tab-mech}
mc_tab <- data.frame(
  M = c("Adult progression tied to childhood rates", paste0("Prior-A exclusion at age ", BAGE + 1), "Too few adult exits",
        "Falling GBD case fatality"),
  E = c(paste0("GBD child / adult case fatality ", fmt_pct(I$mech$cf_child, 2), " / ", fmt_pct(I$mech$cf_adult, 2), " (Indonesia)"),
        paste0("Prevalence 20--24: ", fmt_f(I$mech$prev_2024), " / ", fmt_f(U$mech$prev_2024), " $\\times$ GBD"),
        paste0("Uganda prevalence 60+: ", fmt_f(U$mech$prev_60p), " $\\times$ GBD"),
        paste0("Deaths per case ", fmt_pct(I$mech$gbd_cf_change), " / ", fmt_pct(U$mech$gbd_cf_change), ", ", MF, "--", CY)),
  W = c(paste0("Childhood deaths need fast progression; adults inherit it at ", fmt_f(M_AD), "$\\times$ the hazard and still over-progress"),
        paste0("Child A counts as RHD; the same lesion stops counting at ", BAGE + 1),
        paste0("Adult B leaves only via ", fmt_pct(I$nh$p_B_to_no_rhd_adult), " normalisation or progression"),
        "Constant natural history cannot reproduce a declining trend"))
names(mc_tab) <- c("Mechanism", "Evidence", "Why it binds")
kb(mc_tab, "lll", widths = c("3.6cm", "4.6cm", "4.6cm"), font = 9)
```

\srcline Evidence from the saved Layer-2 targets and fit (Indonesia / Uganda where two values are shown).

::: notes
Time: 1.5 min (cumulative 23.0). Children enter only stage A, and adult B to C and C to D are the childhood rates scaled by one fixed hazard multiplier (`r fmt_f(M_AD)`), so reaching the childhood case fatality GBD reports still inflates adult deaths; the multiplier narrows that gap but the refit offsets part of it by raising childhood B to C. Prior-A exclusion creates the 20–24 dip. Adult exits are too slow for GBD's declining prevalence with age in Uganda. And GBD's case fatality falls over 2010–2019, which constant natural history cannot reproduce. Each is a fixed assumption, so fixing it is a decision, not a tuning step. Transition: what changing them achieved in scratch tests.
:::

## `r if (is.null(ALT)) "Scratch-only alternative tests are described in the checkpoint note" else "In the 5 Nov scratch tests no variant passed; adult parameters plus prior-A in prevalence came closest"`

```{r tab-alt}
if (is.null(ALT)) {
  kb(data.frame(Note = "Checkpoint note (dev/checkpoint\\_first\\_diagnosis\\_2026-11-05.md) not available at render time."), "l")
} else {
  at <- copy(ALT); setnames(at, c("Variant", "IDN prevalence (all / 20+)", "IDN deaths (all / 0--19 / 20+)",
                                  "UGA prevalence (all / 20+)", "UGA deaths (all / 0--19 / 20+)", "Pass?"))
  at[, `Pass?` := sub("^(no|yes)\\b.*$", "\\1", `Pass?`)]
  at[, Variant := sub("^Current spec.*$", "Shared rates (5 Nov run)", Variant)]   # no longer the current model
  kb(at, "llllll", widths = c("2.5cm", "1.8cm", "2.3cm", "1.9cm", "2.3cm", "0.7cm"), font = 7)
}
```

\srcline Scratch tests on the previous shared-rate model (dev/ checkpoint note; not saved outputs). The current model fixes the adult multiplier at `r fmt_f(M_AD)`.

::: notes
Time: 1.0 min (cumulative 24.0). These tests predate the adult multiplier. Freeing three adult parameters (adult B to C, C to D and B normalisation) cut the death ratios most. Counting prior-A as prevalence removed the 20–24 dip and brought prevalence within tolerance, but deaths still drifted above tolerance in later years. The adopted fixed multiplier is a restricted version of the first idea: one fixed adult reduction on B to C and C to D rather than freely estimated adult rates. Transition: who gets diagnosed, and at what stage.
:::

## In `r MF`–`r CY`, `r fmt_pct(I$sc$first_diagnosis_stage[age_at_diagnosis == ">20" & stage == "B", model_share], 0)` of Indonesia's adult first diagnoses are stage B, against a provisional benchmark of `r fmt_pct(I$sc$first_diagnosis_stage[age_at_diagnosis == ">20" & stage == "B", benchmark_share], 0)`

Time: 1.0 min (cumulative 25.75). The model carries the calibrated state forward; it is never reset to GBD. Prevalence entering `r Y0` is `r rel_phrase(I$prev_y0 / I$gbd_prev)` GBD `r I$g_last` in Indonesia and `r rel_phrase(U$prev_y0 / U$gbd_prev)` in Uganda. Every effect below is measured against this baseline. Transition: diagnosed versus undiagnosed disease.

## Scale-up raises the diagnosed share of classifiable RHD to `r fmt_pct(I$ycut("sap", YE)$diag / I$ycut("sap", YE)$sick, 0)` in Indonesia and `r fmt_pct(U$ycut("sap", YE)$diag / U$ycut("sap", YE)$sick, 0)` in Uganda by `r YE`

## Scale-up averts about `r fmt_h(I$averted)` RHD deaths in Indonesia and `r fmt_h(U$averted)` in Uganda by `r Y1`, `r if (max(I$rel_cum, U$rel_cum) < 0.01) "under 1\\% of reference-arm deaths" else paste0("up to ", fmt_pct(max(I$rel_cum, U$rel_cum), 1), " of reference-arm deaths")`

```{r fig-deaths, fig.height = 2.15}

dl <- melt(dd, id.vars = c("country", "year"), variable.name = "arm", value.name = "v")
lab <- dl[year == lab_year(I$yy, 0.83)][, v := v * fifelse(arm == "ref", 1.12, 0.80)]
lab[, txt := fifelse(arm == "ref", "Reference", "Scale-up")]
ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = dd, aes(year, ymin = pmin(sap, ref), ymax = pmax(sap, ref)), fill = col_sap, alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = dl, aes(year, v, colour = arm), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = lab, aes(year, v, label = txt, colour = arm), family = "Calibri", size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ country, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(ref = col_ref, sap = col_sap)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, limits = c(0, NA), n.breaks = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(c(Y0, YE, Y1))) +
  theme_deck
```

\srcline Annual RHD deaths. Cumulative reduction: `r fmt_pct(I$rel_cum, 2)` (Indonesia) and `r fmt_pct(U$rel_cum, 2)` (Uganda) of reference-arm deaths, `r Y0`--`r Y1`; `r fmt_h(I$averted_ye)` and `r fmt_n(U$averted_ye)` of the totals occur by `r YE`.

::: notes
Time: 1.0 min (cumulative 27.5). SAP acts only through the assumed slowing of A to B and B to C among people on BPG aged `r AMAX` or below; deaths come only from D, reached through progression, so averted deaths lag and are bounded by who is on BPG and how adherent they are. Deaths first differ in `r I$first_eff` (Indonesia) and `r U$first_eff` (Uganda). Remember the baseline deaths are several times GBD. Transition: what the programme delivers.
:::

## By `r YE` scale-up delivers `r fmt_f(I$ycut("sap", YE)$enc / 1e6, 1)` million screens a year in Indonesia but adds only `r fmt_n(I$ycut("sap", YE)$dx_scr - I$ycut("ref", YE)$dx_scr)` screen-detected first diagnoses

```{r tab-volumes}

             c("First diagnoses via screening", "dx_scr", "n"), c("First diagnoses, clinical", "dx_clin", "n"),

  a = vapply(qrow, function(x) vv(I, "ref", x[2], if (x[3] == "m") fm2 else fk), ""),
  b = vapply(qrow, function(x) vv(I, "sap", x[2], if (x[3] == "m") fm2 else fk), ""),
  c = vapply(qrow, function(x) vv(U, "ref", x[2], if (x[3] == "m") fm2 else fk), ""),
```

\srcline Counts from the engine's care trace; m = million. Encounters include people without RHD. On-BPG person-years: confirmed A ($\leq `r BAGE`$) and B.

::: notes
Time: 1.0 min (cumulative 28.5). Undiagnosed disease is a tiny fraction of the screened population, so millions of encounters yield thousands of first diagnoses. Clinical detection still produces most first diagnoses, even with scale-up. Transition: who is on prophylaxis.

## `r fmt_pct(I$nobenB_share_ye, 0)` (Indonesia) and `r fmt_pct(U$nobenB_share_ye, 0)` (Uganda) of scale-up BPG person-years in `r YE` are stage B at age `r AMAX + 1L` or over, costed with no modelled benefit

```{r fig-sap, fig.height = 2.0}

lab_cb <- paste0("B, age <=", BAGE); lab_ca <- paste0("A, age <=", BAGE)
sp <- rbindlist(lapply(COUNTRIES, function(ct) R[[ct]]$agg[, .(country = ct, scenario, year,

setnames(sp, c("v1", "v2", "v3", "v4"), c(lab_nb, lab_ad, lab_cb, lab_ca))
spl <- melt(sp[scenario == "sap"], id.vars = c("country", "scenario", "year"), variable.name = "group", value.name = "v")

```

\srcline Scale-up arm, people on BPG by stage and attained age (person-years). Every on-BPG person-year is costed; the assumed progression benefit applies only at ages $\leq `r AMAX`$. The adherence-weighted exposure (on BPG $\times$ $a$) counts every age: `r fmt_pct(I$noben_prot_share_ye, 0)` (Indonesia) and `r fmt_pct(U$noben_prot_share_ye, 0)` (Uganda) of it in `r YE` is at ages $\geq `r AMAX + 1L`$, where it confers no modelled benefit.

::: notes
Time: 0.75 min (cumulative 29.25). Under the assumed default, adult B at `r BAGE + 1` to `r AMAX` now benefits; B at `r AMAX + 1` and over stays on BPG, is costed, and has no modelled progression benefit. The protection age is not a stopping rule: dropout and stage exit still end BPG. Whether and how SAP benefits adults is a decision for collaborators. Transition: the cost composition.
:::

\srcline Benefit = deaths averted $\times$ VSL only (reference case: PPP income elasticity `r fmt_f(EL, 1)`, floor `r FL`$\times$ GNI per capita; `r Y0` VSL `r fmt_usd(round(I$vsl0, -3))` and `r fmt_usd(round(U$vsl0, -3))`). Per resident: discounted net benefit / `r Y0` population. m = million. Deterministic; sensitivity analysis pending; costs understated by the confirmation cost.

::: notes
Time: 1.0 min (cumulative 31.0). Indonesia's ratio rests on benefits accruing late in the horizon: the unfloored VSL grows at `r fmt_pct((1 + I$ep$gdp_growth)^I$va$time_elasticity - 1, 1)` a year (income growth `r fmt_pct(I$ep$gdp_growth, 1)` at elasticity `r fmt_f(I$va$time_elasticity, 1)`) against a `r fmt_pct(I$ep$disc_rate)` discount rate, so `r fmt_pct(I$ben_late)` of Indonesia's discounted benefit (`r fmt_pct(U$ben_late)` of Uganda's) accrues after `r YE`. In international dollars (purchasing power), the totals are `r fmt_f(I$xr_int, 2)` and `r fmt_f(U$xr_int, 2)` times larger; the ratios are unchanged. `r if (bcr_ok[2] && U$es$bcr < 1) "Uganda's falls below one." else ""` Neither should be quoted: the baseline overstates deaths and the SAP effect is an assumed scenario, absent from age `r AMAX + 1L`. Transition: the horizon.
:::

## A credible fit still needs a decision on a fixed assumption; the adopted adult multiplier is a partial step


\srcline Options 1--2: scratch tests on the previous shared-rate specification (dev/checkpoint\_first\_diagnosis\_2026-11-05.md). Option 3: the saved production runs in this deck (scored `r MF`--`r CY`). Passing the death tolerance in every scored year would additionally need a historical case-fatality or care trend, or a different scoring rule.

::: notes
Time: 1.0 min (cumulative 33.0). The current model takes the most restricted step: a single fixed adult reduction on progression, not estimated. In the Indonesia scratch test it lowered the total loss by about 15 percent against shared rates, mostly through the death terms, but adult deaths stay well above GBD and adult prevalence falls slightly. Option 1 still makes the A definition consistent across age 21 and lets adults progress at their own estimated rate; it is a change to the specification, so it needs agreement. Transition: the remaining limitations.
:::

## {.standout}

On preliminary runs, scale-up returns `r if (bcr_ok[1]) paste0("US\\$", fmt_f(I$es$bcr, 1)) else "an undefined ratio"` (Indonesia) and `r if (bcr_ok[2]) paste0("US\\$", fmt_f(U$es$bcr, 1)) else "an undefined ratio"` (Uganda) per dollar through `r Y1` --- but the calibration fails and the SAP progression effect is assumed, not estimated, so these numbers are not yet usable.

::: notes
Time: 0.25 min (cumulative 33.75). Pause here, then open the discussion.
:::

## Five collaborator decisions will define the next model version

1. Should the fixed adult hazard multiplier (`r fmt_f(M_AD)`) give way to adult rates estimated from data, and should adult normalisation be estimated?
2. Should adult prior-A count as RHD prevalence, to match the GBD case definition across age 21?
3. Should the calibration reproduce GBD's falling case fatality, or score fewer years?
4. Is the assumed `r fmt_pct(RRR_SAP)` progression-hazard reduction to age `r AMAX` acceptable, and should stage B at `r AMAX + 1L`+ stay on BPG?
5. What does a confirmatory echo cost, and what completion rate is realistic?

::: notes
Time: 6.25 min (cumulative 40.0). Leave this slide up for the discussion. Questions 1–3 decide whether the baseline becomes credible; 4 and 5 change costs and benefits directly.
:::

## Layer 2 minimises normalised log errors with child and adult components plus weak priors

$$
\begin{aligned}
L_2={}&w_P\big[p\,\bar\ell_{P,0\text{-}19}+(1-p)\,\bar\ell_{P,20+}\big]+w_D\big[s\,\bar\ell_{D,0\text{-}19}+(1-s)\,\bar\ell_{D,20+}\big]+w_I\bar\ell_I\\
&+\lambda\Big[\sum_k\frac{(\mathrm{logit}\,p_k-\mathrm{logit}\,p^0_k)^2}{\sigma_p^2}+\sum_{b,s}\frac{(\ln\alpha_{bs})^2}{\sigma_\alpha^2}\Big]+\lambda_\Delta\sum_{s}\sum_b(\Delta^2\ln\alpha_{bs})^2
\end{aligned}
$$

$\bar\ell$: weighted mean of $[\ln(X^{\mathrm{mod}}+1)-\ln(X^{\mathrm{tgt}}+1)]^2$ over unmasked cells, both sexes pooled. $w_P, w_D, w_I$ = `r fmt_f(I$oc$weights[["W_PREV"]], 1)`, `r fmt_f(I$oc$weights[["W_DEATH"]], 1)`, `r fmt_f(I$oc$weights[["W_INC"]], 1)`; $p$ = `r fmt_f(I$oc$weights[["prev_child_share"]], 1)`, $s$ = `r fmt_f(I$oc$weights[["death_child_share"]], 1)`; $\lambda$ = `r fmt_f(I$oc$lambda_prior_structural, 2)`, $\lambda_\Delta$ = `r I$sc$priors$lambda_smooth_alpha`; $\sigma_p$ = `r I$sc$priors$sigma_trans`, $\sigma_\alpha$ = `r I$sc$priors$sigma_alpha`. Optimum $L$ = `r fmt_f(I$oc$L_min, 3)` (Indonesia), `r fmt_f(U$oc$L_min, 3)` (Uganda); prior / data `r fmt_f(I$oc$prior_over_data_ratio, 2)` and `r fmt_f(U$oc$prior_over_data_ratio, 2)`.
