```{r tab-loss}
        "Deaths (weighted)", "Prior: transitions", "Prior: incidence $\\alpha$", "Smoothness: $\\alpha$")
```

```{r tab-fit-sex}
  c = vapply(rows, function(x) fs(U, x[1], "Female", x[2]), ""), d = vapply(rows, function(x) fs(U, x[1], "Male", x[2]), ""))
names(fs_tab) <- c(paste0(CY, ": target / Number"), "Female", "Male", "Female", "Male")
kb(fs_tab, "lrrrr", widths = c("3.4cm", "2.0cm", "2.0cm", "2.0cm", "2.0cm"), font = 9) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Indonesia" = 2, "Uganda" = 2))
```

\srcline Model / (GBD rate $\times$ WPP) and model / GBD published Number. Uganda's WPP population exceeds GBD's, so its rate-based targets are higher than published counts.

```{r agesex-prep, include=FALSE}
# GBD target vs model counts by GBD age group x sex, from the saved 04b fit table
# (cells without a GBD target are dropped from both bars). Window = annual mean.
CY0 <- as.integer(I$cal$meta$calib_year_start)
age_short <- function(g) sub(" years$", "", sub("^12-23 months$", "1", sub("^<1 year$", "<1", g)))
agesex_d <- function(r, yrs) {
  d <- r$fl[year %in% yrs & measure %in% c("Prevalence", "Deaths", "Incidence") & !is.na(target_used),
            .(Model = sum(model) / length(yrs), GBD = sum(target_used) / length(yrs), glo = glo[1]), by = .(measure, sex, age_group)]
  d <- melt(d, id.vars = c("measure", "sex", "age_group", "glo"), variable.name = "src", value.name = "n")
  lv <- unique(d[order(glo), age_group])
  d[, `:=`(age = factor(age_short(age_group), levels = age_short(lv)),
           measure = factor(measure, levels = c("Prevalence", "Deaths", "Incidence"),
                            labels = c("Prevalence", "Deaths", "Incidence")),
           src = factor(as.character(src), levels = c("GBD", "Model")))]
  d
}
agesex_ratio <- function(d, m) d[measure == m, sum(n[src == "Model"]) / sum(n[src == "GBD"])]
agesex_title <- function(r, yrs) { d <- agesex_d(r, yrs)
  paste0(r$ct, ", ", if (length(yrs) == 1) yrs else paste0(min(yrs), "–", max(yrs), " (annual mean)"),
         ": model / GBD is ", fmt_f(agesex_ratio(d, "Prevalence")), " for prevalent cases, ",
         fmt_f(agesex_ratio(d, "Deaths")), " for deaths and ", fmt_f(agesex_ratio(d, "Incidence")), " for incidence") }
k_lab <- function(x) ifelse(abs(x) >= 1e3, paste0(formatC(x / 1e3, format = "fg", digits = 3), "k"), formatC(x, format = "fg", digits = 3))
agesex_plot <- function(r, yrs) {
  ggplot(agesex_d(r, yrs), aes(age, n, fill = src)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) +
    facet_grid(measure ~ sex, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(GBD = col_gbd, Model = col_sap),
                      labels = c(GBD = if (identical(I$basis, "number")) "GBD Number" else "GBD target (rate x WPP)", Model = "Model")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = k_lab) +
    theme_deck + theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, -4, 0),
                       legend.text = element_text(size = 8), strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
                       strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, size = 7.5, face = "bold"),
                       axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 5.5),
                       axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
}
AGESEX_SRC <- paste0("Counts per year by GBD age group and sex; GBD = ", basis_label, ". Own y scale per panel. ",
                     "Incidence = new modelled disease (validation only).")
```

## The burn-in converges and the bridge carries the full state to `r Y0` without reseeding

```{r tab-init}
ini <- function(r) { b <- as.data.table(r$sc$burnin_check); br <- as.data.table(r$sc$bridge_reconciliation)
  last_gbd <- br[!grepl("seed", measure) & !is.na(gbd_number)]
  ly <- max(last_gbd$year); seed <- br[grepl("seed", measure)]
  c(paste(r$sc$priors$burn_years, "/", 2L * r$sc$priors$burn_years), fmt_e(max(b$rel_diff_2x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    fmt_f(last_gbd[measure == "Prevalence" & year == ly, ratio_model_over_rate_x_wpp]),
    fmt_f(last_gbd[measure == "Deaths" & year == ly, ratio_model_over_rate_x_wpp]),
    if (nrow(seed)) fmt_f(seed$ratio_model_over_rate_x_wpp) else "n/a",
    fmt_e(r$sc$bridge_handoff_gap)) }
lyr <- max(as.data.table(I$sc$bridge_reconciliation)[!is.na(gbd_number), year])
in_tab <- data.frame(q = c("Burn-in cycles / doubled check", "Largest change, doubled burn-in",
                           paste0("Bridge prevalence / GBD, ", lyr), paste0("Bridge RHD deaths / GBD, ", lyr),
                           paste0("Seed entering ", Y0, " / GBD-rate prevalence"), "Calibration $\\rightarrow$ bridge hand-off gap"),
                     i = ini(I), u = ini(U))
names(in_tab) <- c("", "Indonesia", "Uganda")
kb(in_tab, "lrr", widths = c("7cm", "2.6cm", "2.6cm"))
```

\srcline Zero-start burn-in under `r I$cal$meta$calib_year_start` inputs with per-capita balancing; bridge `r CY + 1L`--`r Y0 - 1L` under reference care. The seed keeps diagnosis, BPG, prior-A, normalised and screening histories.

## `r if (!length(flat_I) && !length(flat_U)) "A one-at-a-time sweep flags no parameter as flat" else paste0("A one-at-a-time sweep flags ", length(flat_I), " (Indonesia) and ", length(flat_U), " (Uganda) parameters as prior-dominated")`

```{r tab-ident}
cell <- function(dt, p) { r <- dt[parameter == p]
  if (!nrow(r)) return("--")
  v <- fmt_f(r$flatness)
  if (r$status != "data-identified") paste0("\\prov{\\textbf{", v, "}}") else v }
bands <- I$cal$meta$bands
id_tab <- rbind(
  data.frame(Parameter = unname(tp_lab[tp_rows[1:6]]),
             Indonesia = vapply(tp_rows[1:6], function(p) cell(I$ident, p), ""),
             Uganda = vapply(tp_rows[1:6], function(p) cell(U$ident, p), "")),
  data.frame(Parameter = paste0("Incidence $\\alpha$, ", bands, " (F / M)"),
             Indonesia = vapply(bands, function(b) paste(cell(I$ident, sprintf("alpha[%s|Female]", b)), "/", cell(I$ident, sprintf("alpha[%s|Male]", b))), ""),
             Uganda = vapply(bands, function(b) paste(cell(U$ident, sprintf("alpha[%s|Female]", b)), "/", cell(U$ident, sprintf("alpha[%s|Male]", b))), "")))
kb(id_tab, "lrr", widths = c("4.6cm", "2.6cm", "2.6cm"), font = 8)
```

\srcline Flatness: share of a parameter's range within the near-optimal band, others at the optimum; amber = prior-dominated. Weaker than joint identification.

```{r abstract-prep, include=FALSE}
abs_p <- file.path(ROOT, "dev", "Abstract WCRHD26 DW_NM.docx")
ABS <- NULL
if (file.exists(abs_p)) {
  td <- tempfile("abs"); dir.create(td)
  xml <- utils::unzip(abs_p, files = "word/document.xml", exdir = td)
  txt <- gsub("\\s+", " ", gsub("<[^>]+>", "", paste(readLines(xml, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = " ")))
  grab <- function(re) { m <- regmatches(txt, regexec(re, txt))[[1]]; if (length(m) == 3) m[2:3] else c("n/a", "n/a") }
  ABS <- list(deaths = grab("avert ([0-9,]+) and ([0-9,]+) RHD deaths"),
              red = grab("representing a ([0-9]+)% and ([0-9]+)% reduction"),
              bcr = grab("ratios of ([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+) and ([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)"))
  unlink(td, recursive = TRUE)
}
av <- function(i) if (is.null(ABS)) c("n/a", "n/a") else ABS[[i]]
```

## No sensitivity analysis exists yet; these analyses are planned

- **Structural:** adult progression multiplier (now fixed at `r fmt_f(M_AD)`) and adult normalisation; prior-A in prevalence; direct advanced entry in children
- **Calibration:** prevalence : death weights; death-trend handling; target basis
- **One-way:** assumed SAP progression multiplier $M$ and protection age (GOAL-trial child hazard ratios as the documented alternative); BPG initiation, retention, adherence; confirmation completion; screening window target
- **Economic:** confirmation unit cost; VSL reference value, income elasticity and floor; income growth; discount rate; unit costs and their price years
- **Probabilistic:** transitions and incidence multipliers within bounds

\srcline The pipeline is deterministic; none of the results in this deck carry uncertainty intervals.

```{r discrepancies-prep, include=FALSE}
# Discrepancy log. Configuration and documentation are read as text, never sourced.

i_tr <- grep("^incidence_trend <- switch\\(COUNTRY", cfg)
cfg_tr <- if (length(i_tr)) sub(".*Indonesia = ([0-9.]+).*", "\\1",
                                grep("Indonesia =", cfg[i_tr:(i_tr + 3)], value = TRUE)[1]) else "not parsed"
run_through <- sub('.*"(.*)".*', "\\1", grep("^PIPELINE_RUN_THROUGH <-", cfg, value = TRUE)[1])
cmd <- tryCatch(readLines(file.path(ROOT, "CLAUDE.md"), warn = FALSE), error = function(e) character())
cmd_stale <- length(cmd) > 0 && !any(grepl("first_diagnosis|first-diagnosis", cmd))
smoke <- tryCatch(readLines(file.path(ROOT, "tests", "test_abcd_smoke.R"), warn = FALSE), error = function(e) character())

                    if (identical(cfg_tr, fmt_f(I$trend, 3))) " (consistent)" else " (differs)"),
             paste0("PIPELINE\\_RUN\\_THROUGH = ", run_through, ": 05--08 run under a user override of the failed fit"),
             if (cmd_stale) "CLAUDE.md still describes the October (pre-first-diagnosis) structure" else "Consistent",
             if (smoke_stale) "tests/ target an earlier engine signature and output columns" else "Consistent",
```

```{r tab-prov-1}
brk <- function(x) gsub("\\\\_", "\\\\_\\\\allowbreak{}", gsub("/", "/\\\\allowbreak{}", x))
pv1$Artifact <- brk(pv1$Artifact); pv1$Object <- brk(pv1$Object)
kb(pv1, "llllll", widths = c("1.8cm", "1.1cm", "2.9cm", "2.6cm", "1.7cm", "1.5cm"), font = 7)
```

## Provenance (2/2): service, cost and economic results trace to saved objects

```{r tab-prov-2}
pv2 <- data.frame(
  Result = c("Care inputs, seed", "Service volumes", "Cost composition", "Economic summary", "Uncosted confirmation",

  Script = c("05", "06", "06, 08", "08", "06, 08", "none", "none"),

               "output/<C>/tables/rhd\\_economic\\_results.rds", "same", "dev/*.xlsx", "dev/checkpoint\\_first\\_diagnosis\\_2026-11-05.md"),
  Object = c("\\$states[[1]]\\$coverage, \\$seed\\_state", "\\$stages n\\_screened, n\\_confirm\\_completed, n\\_on\\_optimal\\_treatment",
             "\\$stages volumes $\\times$ \\$params unit costs", "\\$summary, \\$incremental", "\\$budget\\_impact, \\$params",
```

\srcline `<C>` = Indonesia or Uganda; paths relative to the repository root. The deck reads these files and writes nothing.

## Rendering needs only the saved artifacts, R and a XeLaTeX toolchain

- Render: `rmarkdown::render("reports/slideck-technical.Rmd")` with XeLaTeX and Calibri; set `RHD_REPO_ROOT` when rendering a copy outside the repository
- Inputs: artifacts of scripts 01–08 for both countries; a missing file stops the render and names its producing script
- Checks: engine and specification, seed = bridged state, reference care = reference arm, care trajectories, SAP trace, nesting, volumes and economics agree for each country
- Software: `r R.version.string`; rmarkdown `r packageVersion("rmarkdown")`; knitr `r packageVersion("knitr")`; data.table `r packageVersion("data.table")`; ggplot2 `r packageVersion("ggplot2")`; kableExtra `r packageVersion("kableExtra")`
- Saved: calibration `r format(file.mtime(file.path(ROOT, "data", "Indonesia", "calibrated_rhd_parameters.rds")), "%Y-%m-%d")` / `r format(file.mtime(file.path(ROOT, "data", "Uganda", "calibrated_rhd_parameters.rds")), "%Y-%m-%d")`; model outputs `r format(file.mtime(file.path(ROOT, "output", "Indonesia", "out_model", "Indonesia.rds")), "%Y-%m-%d")` / `r format(file.mtime(file.path(ROOT, "output", "Uganda", "out_model", "Uganda.rds")), "%Y-%m-%d")` (Indonesia / Uganda)
